tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi do ha rdo rje'i tshig

rkang dang mgur dbyangs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa thos pa don ldan byin rlabs rgya mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / dpal rdo rje 'chang gi rgyal tshab bcu pa'i dbang phyug rtsod pa med pa'i grub thob kyi phreng ba bar ma chad du byon pa 'gro mgon shangs pa bka' brgyud ces 'jig rten gsum na yongs su grags shing khyad par du 'phags pa'i che ba'i yon tan ngo mtshar du mas brgyan pa de dag gi zhabs kyis pad+mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis rdo rje mi shigs pa nā da'i rang sgras rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud zab mo gdams ngag dmar khrid kyi tshig rkang du rtsal ba nas bzung ste/ bka' brgyud rin chen phreng ba rim par byon pa rnams kyis gnas lugs chos sku'i rgyal sa zin te nyams dang rtogs pa'i gzi byin rab tu 'bar ba las dgongs pa zab mo'i nyams skyug do ha rdo rje'i dbyangs kyi gad mo mkha' khyab tu sgrog pa rnams kyi nang nas/ rnal 'byor pa rnams la dad gus kyi gsos sbyin pa dang*/ zhen log nges 'byung gi skul lcag 'debs pa dang*/ nyams myong gong nas gong du spel ba dang*/ rtogs pa'i ye shes la dpa' tshan skyed pa dang*/ dpa' bo ḍā ki rnams dgyes pa bskyed pa dang*/ gegs dang bar chad kyi 'phrang las sgrol ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba mtha' yas pa chos kyi sbyin pa bla na med pas tshim par bya ba'i slad du cung zad cig gus pas bsgrag par bya ba las/ thog mar sngon 'gro chos spyod kyi rim pa dang ting nge 'dzin gsal 'debs pa la 'jug par zhu/ zhes bskul te/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skyabs kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la skyabs su mchi ba lags so/ / lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du do ha rdo rje dbyangs kyi bzlas rim la 'jug par bgyi'o/

/ lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ mgur len pa po rnams tha mal gyi rtog pa spangs te rnal 'byor gyi rim pa la gnas dgos pas de gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ snod bcud dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams/ gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*/ phyi nang kun tu rgyan dang bkod pa dang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ tshogs kyi 'dus pa dpal he ru ka lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i thugs ka nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad snang ba'i 'od zer chen po 'phros pas bskul te/ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' khyab chos sku'i rol pa la/ /gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*/ /gang 'dul ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /mos pa'i yid mkhar mngon gsal te/ /don mdzad bar du brtan par bzhugs/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlobs/ /pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ bkod pa shin tu mdzes pa'i sogs man+ṭal bka' rgya ma phul/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de'ang mos gus gsol 'debs dang bcas te mgur gyi sna 'dren/ nyams rtogs dpa' ngar dang bcas te mgur gyi gzhung bsrang/ dga' spro'i shis brjod dang bcas te mgur gyi mjug sdud pa bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag bzhes lags pas/ thog mar rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos tha mal gyi snang ba 'phrog /blo sna btsan thabs su sgyur/ rtogs pa'i ye shes gong du spor bar nus pa'i gsol 'debs kyi mgur gra legs par bsgrig par zhu/ na mo gu ru/ rigs kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /pha drin chen bla ma la gsol ba 'debs/ /drwa ba sdom mdzad bde ba'i mchog /dpal he ru ka la gsol ba 'debs/

/dbyings bde stong zag med dkyil 'khor na/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mkha' spyod longs sku'i zhing khams na/ /yum su kha sid+dhi la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas gang 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang na/ /mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyud mthar thug lnga ldan ṭā ki'i sras/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la gsol ba 'debs/ /srid mtha' ma'i byang sems gcig brgyud 'dzin/ /rje rmog lcogs pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /lha spyan ras gzigs dbang gtsang sgom gzugs/ /rje skyer sgang pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rigs drug pa'i khyab bdag sbas pa'i tshul/ /rje gnyan ston chen po la gsol ba 'debs/ /brgyud rin chen bdun gyi rnam thar rdzogs/ /rje sangs rgyas ston pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /bka' brgyud pa'i chu klung 'babs pa'i gzhi/ /rje mkhas grub rnam gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar 'phrin las can/ /dpal 'jag bsam brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje tshul khrims mgon dang ri khrod pa/ /shangs dkar rin chen rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje lkugs lung pa dang nam rgyal ba/ /rgya sgom legs pa rgyal mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkha' 'gro'i rjes bzung 'chi med 'grub/ /rje thang stong rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs/ / brtul zhugs spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /don chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur/ /rje brag stod pa la gsol ba 'debs/ /he ru ka dpal gsang ba'i bdag /rje btsun tā ra nā tha la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal shangs pa'i bka' brgyud 'dzin mdzad pa'i/ / skyes mchog rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas mi shigs 'khor lo lnga yi dbus/ /yi dam rgyud sde lnga la gsol ba 'debs/ /lus dwangs ma 'od lnga'i thig le ru/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro yab yum la gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas snying rje rnam rol dur khrod nas/

/myur mdzad ye shes mgon po la gsol ba 'debs/ /phyi tha snyad 'khrul ba'i snang ba zhig /nang kun rdzob don dam dbyer med rtogs/ /bar chos sku'i rang zhal mngon gyur nas/ khams gsum gyi 'khor ba dong sprugs shog /rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rgyal ba drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos rang snang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro la skye med gnyug ma'i rang sgras 'khor 'das phyag rgya chen po'i rang zhin du ngo sprod pa'i gnas lugs rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di gsungs so/ /bde chen lhun grub 'dus ma byas/ /longs sku rdo rje 'chang chen gyis/ /skye med rang sgra 'di skad thos/ /tha mal shes pa e ma ho/ /sngon 'gro rang bab rnam pa gsum/ /dngos gzhi skyon bzhi rang sar grol/ /mthar thug sku bzhi rang shar ro/ /sngon 'gro'i dam tshig gsang ba'i rdo rje'o/ /bogs 'don snying rje gsol 'debs so/ /lam khyer cir snang de nyid do/ /mngon gyur sgom med yengs med do/ /bsre ba rtog med lam khyer ro/ /'od gsal lta stangs bogs 'don no/ /sad rjes gsal la rtog med bsre/ /nyin mtshan bar do'i 'od gsal ni/ /sku gsum dbyer med rang shar ltos/ /gang gis mi shes rgyud du sbas pa'i don/ /mthar thug tshig gcig grol ba 'di yin te/ /sgom med yengs med goms shing brtan pa las/ /sa lam rim pa dus 'dir bgrod byed pa'i/ / yid la mi byed sgrib gnyis rang sar dag /sku gsum rang shar 'bras bu lhun gyis grub/ /mdo rgyud kun tu bstan kyang rang bzhin gab/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs zhal las shes par bya/ /chos sku'i nam mkhar rtog pa'i sprin tshogs las/ /dug lnga'i glog 'gyu ye shes chen por ltos/ /yid la mi byed re dogs kun bral ba'i/ /tha mal shes pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes rdo rje'i tshig 'di nyid mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la gser srang lnga brgya phul nas zhus te mgul gyi ga'u tsit+ta 'dra ba'i nang du mi 'bral bar bcangs pa'o/

/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gup+ta zhes bya ba dpal nā ro tā pa'i lcam mo rang byung gi rnal 'byor ma sa bcu'i dbang phyug rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dngos kyis rjes su bzung ba de nyid kyis rang grol phyag rgya chen po rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di gsungs so/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi/ /sems nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod pas/ /tha mal rnam rtog dag bya'i phyir/ /rang lus lhar gsal bla ma la/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i mos gus bya/ /bla ma yi dam mi bsams shing*/ /dngos dang dngos med la sogs pa/ /gang yang yid la mi bya bar/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag /rang sems ma bcos chos kyi sku/ / de la ma yengs bsgom pa'i gnad/ /mtha' bral chen por rtogs par bya/ / 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor skyur byed pa'i/ /chags sdang rtog pa sna tshogs 'di/ /skye med mtshon cha rnon po yis/ /rang bzhin med par bcad par bya/ /sdong po'i rtsa ba bcad gyur na/ /yal ga skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dwangs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /chu bur byung zhing chu la thim/ /de bzhin rnam par rtog pa yang*/ /chos nyid min pa gzhan med kyi/ /skyon du ma blta glod la zhog /gang shar gang skyes de nyid la/ /der 'dzin med pas rang sar grol/ /snang grags chos rnams rang gi sems/ /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan med/ /sems ni skye 'gag spros dang bral/ /sems kyi de nyid shes pa des/ /'dod yon lnga la spyad gyur kyang*/ / chos nyid ngang las g.yos pa med/ /dper na gser gling phyin pa yis/ /sa rdo btsal yang mi rnyed ltar/ /mnyam nyid chos dbyings chen po la/ /spang blang mnyam bzhag rjes thob med/ /gang gi tshe na mngon du 'gyur/ /de tshe lhun gyis grub par gyur/ /'gro ba'i re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur/ / gang zag dbang po rab 'bring gsum/ /blo yi rim pas shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/

/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro su kha sid+dhi zhes dpal chen bir+wa pas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs par bskur bas nub gcig la sa brgyad pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur nas rdo rje 'chang dngos su mjal te bcom ldan 'das bdag med ma dang dbyer med pa de nyid kyis skal ldan rnams la gdams pa'i snying po bstsal pa/ /tshogs drug yul du ma spyad pa'i/ /dran med mya ngan 'das pa'i lam/ /rnam par mi rtog chos kyi dbyings/ /yid dang bral bas phyag rgya che/ / ma bsgoms ma bsgoms blo ma bsgoms/ /blos sgom rtog pa'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /rtog pas 'khor bar bcings pa ste/ /blo dang bral ba sgom du med/ /nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ /rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba gcun/ /rtsa ba gcun la lhug par zhog /ces gsungs so/ /༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dpal sha ba ri pas dngos su rjes su bzung zhing bar dor phyag rgya chen po mchog grub par lung bstan pa/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma mtha' yas pa'i gtso bo snying po don gyi gnas lugs yid la mi byed pa'i gdams ngag gi bdag po/ rgyal ba mai tri pa gnyis med rdo rje nyid bi kra ma la shī lar sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'i tshe chang dang phyag rgya bsten pa dge 'dun gyis mthong ste gnas nas dbyung ba na/ chu bo gaṅgā la khri snyan sā la'i lpags gdan bting*/ sba ber gyis skya ba mdzad nas gshegs te mgur 'di bzhengs so/ /bla ma rje btsun bsten na bde/ /gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'thung na bde/ /de nyid nyams su myong na bde/ /nyams myong ci yang med na bde/ /re dogs med pa'i lta ba bde/ /lhun gyis grub na yongs kyang bde/ /gnyis 'dzin med pa'i sgom pa bde/ /gza' gtad med na yongs kyang bde/ /blang dor med pa'i spyod pa bde/ /nyam nga med na yongs kyang bde/ /sems kyis sems la bltas na bde/ /re dogs gol sa bcad na bde/ /ri khrod dgon pa 'grims na bde/

/re dogs med pa'i lta ba bde/ /yul dang gnyen 'dun bzhag na bde/ / bsod snyoms zas la bsten na bde/ /bde chen zas su zos na bde/ /'od gsal gos su gon na bde/ /pho nya lam du khyer na bde/ /dmigs pa sna rtser gtad na bde/ /zhes gsungs nas chu la thad kar thogs med du gshegs pas thams cad kyis grub pa thob par shes nas 'gyod cing phyi nas phar la phyag byas so/ /bla ma mnga' bdag chen po de nyid lho phyogs dpal gyi ri la rje btsun ri khrod pa'i zhabs kyi rdul la reg nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i dus su/ dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la dbab pa'i ched du rdo rje'i glu blangs pa'o/ /hūṃ hūṃ/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa dbyer mi phyed/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin du ni gnas pa yin/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med pa ste/ /dug la sngags kyis btab pa'i khyad par bzhin/ /sems nyid gcig la sna tshogs snang ba ste/ /shel nyid rkyen gyis kha dog bsgyur ba bzhin/ /dngos po sna tshogs shar yang rang sems te/ /chu rnams thams cad rgya mtshor lan tshwa'i ro/ /dngos dang dngos med spangs na gdod ma'i sems/ /dper na bar snang bya yi rjes bzhin gnas/ /lo stong lon pa'i mun pa mthug po la/ /sgron me chung ngu gcig gis sel ba ltar/ /'khor ba'i rab rib chags sdang mthug po yang*/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i skad cig gcig la zhi/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug pas/ /'khor bar sdug bsngal rba rlabs rtog pa zhi/ /nor bu chu dwangs rnyog gseb bcug pa bzhin/ khyab dang gzugs can ma yin 'gro 'ong med/ /phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa skyes ma thag /khyab cing rgya che nam mkha' lta bu'i sems/ / gsal la mi rtog nam mkha' lta bu ste/ /snang yang rang bzhin med pa chu zla 'dra// 'ja' tshon lta bu gsal la 'dzin pa med/ /gzhon nu'i bde ba bzhin tu smra mi btub/ /phyogs su mi gnas mtha' rnams kun dang bral/

/phyogs kyis ma gos gang gi dri ma med/ /shel sgong 'dam na dri ma med pa bzhin/ /re dogs med pa'i sems ni seng ge 'dra/ /chu bo lta bu chad med bde chen sems/ /nyi zla'i 'od bzhin phyogs cha bral ba ste/ /e ma rang byung 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /gnyug ma nyid du zhog cig rnal 'byor pa/ /'di la cis kyang bcos par ma byed cig /ma bcos pa ni chos kyi sku nyid do/ /bcos pa'i skyon gyis 'phags lam mthong mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sems kyi glang po yan du chug /de ltar shes na rnal 'byor snying po ste/ /sgrub tu med par 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob/ /byas pa med par dka' ba'i las rnams zin/ /sgrub pa med par rang la dngos grub thob/ /sgom pa med par don gyi 'bras bu rnyed/ /srid gsum thams cad ye nas grol ba ste/ /'di la dgag dang bsgrub pa bya mi dgos/ /lta ba gtan la phab pa rdo rje'i mgur ro/ /e ma ho/ gnas lugs gnyug ma bsgom par 'dod pa na/ /tshes grangs gza' dang rgyu skar brtsi mi dgos/ /dus kyi rgyal po dran pa'i tshe na yin/ /ri khrod dgon pa ched du mi btsal te/ /rang lus ri bo 'di ni dgon pa'i mchog/ g.yeng ba rnams kyang ched du mi spangs te/ /sna tshogs sems su shes pas grogs su 'char/ /nags la me mched rtswa rnams ji bzhin no/ /mtshams yang mi bcad tho yang mi brtsigs ste/ /smra bcad byas na mtshams kyi mchog tu 'gyur/ /ras bal 'dab ma bzhin du glod la zhog

/bya ba thong la sems kyi rten ma bca'/ / shes pa ched du ma 'gugs yan par thong*/ /bying rgod byung na de kha rang la ltos// sems la gnod pa'i las rnams khad kyis spongs/ /zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par bya/ /ma bcos bzhag pa'i sems ni sangs rgyas yin/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad lhug par zhog /rnam rtog kun gyi rtsa ba sems yin phyir// sems med phyir na rnam rtog yod ma yin/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rten gcig skyes tsam na/ /rnal 'byor pa la zhe 'dod 'byung mi srid/ /de phyir rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde/ /gza' gtad med pa'i lam gcig rnyed tsam na/ /rnal 'byor pa la phyogs cha 'byung mi srid/ /phyogs ris med pa'i shes pa nyams re dga'/ / bcos ma med pa'i rgyun gcig skyes tsam na/ /rnal 'byor pa la blang dor 'byung mi srid/ /dgag sgrub spong len med pa dang re spro/ /mnyam nyid byang chub sems gcig skyes tsam na/ /rnal 'byor pa la bdag gzhan 'byung mi srid/ /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa khod re snyoms/ /srid gsum ye nas grol ba'i ngang la zhog / sgom pa gtan la dbab pa rdo rje'i glu'o/ /a+thi+-i/ e ma ho/ sems kyi bag dang ldan pa spyod pa'i mchog /bag med mi bya dran dang shes bzhin bstan/ /spyod pa gang byed tshad du mi bzung ste/ /gang yang spyod pa byis pa lta bur gyis/ /ma bcos spyod pa bu chung lta bur zhog /nyam nga med pa seng ge lta bur spyod/ /the tshom med pa glang chen chur zhugs bzhin/ / gtsang rme med pa khyi phag lta bur rol/ /gnas kyi ro snyoms bung ba lta bur spyod// rang byung mi dgag smyon pa lta bur zhog /gza' gtad med pa sha za lta bur 'khrungs/ /kun tu rgyu bas 'byung ba rlung bzhin du/ /zhen pa med par 'gro ba 'di ni mchog /gang ltar myong ba skye med rgya yis gdab/ /spyod pa gtan la dbab pa rdo rje'i glu'o/ /re dogs med pa sems nyid gnyug ma des/

/dran pa med pas brjod med ting 'dzin thob/ /skye ba med pas 'gyur med lta ba thob/ /'dzin pa med pas phyogs med spyod pa thob/ /rkyen dang bral bas blo 'das 'bras bu thob/ / byas pa med pas dka' ba'i las rnams zin/ /bsags pa med par zad med gter rnams sogs/ /'dus pa med par 'bral med grogs dang mjal/ /bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu ltar/ /'bras bu rang byung 'di ni ngo mtshar che/ /'bras bu gtan la dbab pa rdo rje'i glu'o/ /'phags yul lho phyogs su sku 'khrungs shing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs khyad par lha bzhis dngos su rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs/ 'chi med rdo rje'i sku brnyes nas bod du phebs shing rdzu 'phrul gyis slar rgya gar du gshegs te ri nag po zhes bya ba shing gi ri'i khong gseng du dngos su bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa grub brnyes rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyams su len par zhal gyi gdams pa 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgongs pa mdor bsdus rnal 'byor gyi/ /tshad med bzhi yi nyams len ni/ /bsam gyis mi khyab bshad par bya/ /rgyu 'bras stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /dngos med gzugs dang gnyis med sgra/ /dmigs med 'bras bu 'bad med 'gyur/ /dper na 'brug med char bzhin no/ /de phyir rang bzhin bdag med kyi/ /brtul zhugs skal ldan rnal 'byor pa/ /snang zhing srid pa sna tshogs 'di/ /dngos med stong pa bdag med de// ngo bo nyid kyi rnam par dag /de lta bu yi snying rje la/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su med/ /mi bsgoms mi rtog rang bzhin gsal/ /mtha' dbus bral ba dbu ma'i don/ /de ltar sems kyi rang bzhin bsgom/ /ma rtogs pa yi sems can la/ /nad 'don snying rje bsgom par bya/ /bdag gi mdun du gang zhig kyang*/ /mnyam par bzhag ste mnyam par bsgom/

/de la rnam pa thams cad kyis/ /gnyis med don ni 'grub 'gyur ro/ /sgom pa'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ /kun gyi sems nyid hūṃ yig dkar/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi snying gar bsgom/ /nyi ma'i gdan steng thig ler bsgom/ /de nyid kyis ni 'gro 'dul ba/ / nyon mongs thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ /de ni gnyis med don yin te/ /lha yi de nyid rang bzhin med/ /de ltar snying rje bsgoms byas nas/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i byams pa ni/ /phan phyir 'di ltar bsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid snying ga ru/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad sran ma'i tshad/ /de nas 'od gsal dkar dmar de/ /bar du me lha'i oṃ yig ni/ /dngos po'i rnal 'byor gang yang med/ /de la ci yang bsam mi bya/ /gang zhig sgom pa'i rnal 'byor de/ /gnyis med ye shes 'grub 'gyur ro/ /gsal rig med pa chos kyi sku/ /de ltar phra ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /mngon shes shar te gnyis med rtogs/ /dga' ba'i rang bzhin 'byung gyur la/ /btang snyoms 'bras bu thob pa'o/ kha cig lha bzhi sgom ste gnas/ kha cig ngag gi 'don par brten/ /gnyis med sgom pa mi shes so/ /zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa yi/ /zhal gdams gzhan la phan phyir ni/ /rā hu las ni bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'chi med grub pa rā hu la gup+ta de nyid bla ma grub thob rnams kyis lung bstan pa ltar/ 'phags yul du nyi ma shar ba la rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs pas bod yul du nam langs ma thag par mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor 'phan yul 'jog por thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i sar phebs shing rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa bstan/ zla ba bcu gcig bzhugs nas thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i gdams ngag du ma gnang ste rgya gar du slar phebs pa'i tshe/ bla ma shangs pa nyid mang yul bar du gshegs skyel 'byon pa na zhal gdams rdo rje'i tshig drug ma 'di bstsal to/ /sdug bsngal rtsa bar gyur pa/

/bdag tu 'dzin pa yin gyis/ / phyogs ris zhe 'dod spongs la/ /mnyam nyid don la zhog cig /tshe 'di mi rtag 'gyur zhing*/ /phyi ma mi 'char skye bas/ /rgyu 'bras tshul bzhin bsrungs la/ /dam tshig brtson par gyis shig /gnas lugs zung 'jug yin pas/ /'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus 'di/ /snang la rang bzhin med par/ /rtag tu dran par gyis shig /tshe 'dir dgos 'dod 'byung zhing*/ /phyi ma lam sna 'dren pas/ /bla ma sangs rgyas lta bu/ /rtag tu dran par gyis shig /brtan pa ma thob bar du/ /'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba rgod pas/ /ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du/ /gcig pur nyams su longs shig /rtsod ldan dus kyi sems can/ /nga rgyal phrag dog che bas/ /bum nang mar me bzhin du/ /yon tan sems la sbos shig /ces gsungs nas nam mkha'i lam la gya gyur bzhud pa'i tshul gyis skad cig gis rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dpon la phebs so/ / ༈ na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams kun tu mtshan gyis snyan pas yongs su khyab cing*/ zhabs sen nor bu'i me long la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug gi phud bus btud pa/ gangs can gyi ljongs na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i mkhas grub chen po khyung po rnal 'byor tshul khrims mgon po de nyid kyi rnam par thar pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa tshigs su bcad de bka' bstsal pa ni/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la/ khyung po rnal 'byor bdag gis gus btud nas/ /phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /rnam thar zur tsam bshad kyi gus pas nyon/ /ban chung bdag gi skye sa gangs dkar mda'/ /gnye mo ra mang rje rigs khyung po yin/ /pha ru smos pa khyung rgyal stag skyes dang*/ /ma ru smos pa mgo bza' bkra shis skyid/ /de yi rum du bdag nyid zhugs pa'i tshe/ /pha ma yul mi bde skyid ldan par gyur/ /stag gi lo la ma yi rum nas btsas/ /de tshe rgya gar grub thob a mo ghas/

/'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar bgrod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob thams cad kyi/ /thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol byed/ /sna tshogs sprul pas gdul bya 'dul bar 'gyur/ /theg chen snying po mtha' bral chos sgra sgrog /mthar thug gsang sngags bde stong dbyer med kyi/ /seng ge'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog par 'gyur// de yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ /gsung ni ma hā mā yā'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje ste/ /sprul pa'i gnas mchog gsang ba 'dus pa la/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gshin rje'i gshed du 'gyur/ / dkyil 'khor de rnams lus la bkod nas kyang*/ /gdul bya rnams la dngos su ston par byed/ /gzhan yang yi dam sna tshogs gzugs bsgyur nas/ /gdul dka' skye bo dpag med 'dul bar byed/ /lo ni brgya dang lnga bcu 'tsho bar 'gyur/ /de yi mthar ni mdzad pa brtul ba'i tshe/ /ltas dang rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs ston par 'gyur/ /de nas zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can/ /rgyal ba kun bsngags zhing der sangs rgyas nas/ /theg chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'gyur/ /phyi rabs dad ldan gdul bya thams cad kun/ /rgyal ba'i zhing der bgrod par the tshom med/ /de skad gsungs nas bla ma grub thob de/ /mkha' la bya bzhin rgya gar yul du gshegs/ /lo lnga lon nas pha mes lung bstan bshad// lo bcu lon nas yig rtsis mkhas par shes/ /bcu gnyis lon tshe pha mes bag chags kyis/ /sems phyogs bon bslab rdzogs chen phyag chen bslab/ /de nas rin chen gser phye phongs med khyer/ /gces pa'i srog la ma bltas dka' spyad nas/ /rgya dang bal po'i yul du lan bdun phyin/ /rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ khyad par mkhas shing grub thob lnga bcu dang*/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rnam bzhi bsten/ /longs sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /dngos su chos gsan ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis/

/mnyes par byas nas mthar thug gdams ngag zhus/ /sgro 'dogs chod nas rtse gcig bsgrubs pa yis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /rnam thar mdor bstan yin gyi gus pas nyon/ /de ltar ji skad bka' bstsal pa'i mkhas grub shangs pa gdu gu pa de nyid thog mar bon la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes/ de nas 'byung gnas seng ge las rdzogs chen sde gsum/ skor ni ru pa las phyag rgya chen po'i rgyud rgya gzhung sogs gzhung gdams mang du gsan cing thams cad la mkhas pa'i phul du gyur kyang*/ sngon gyi las 'phro sad de dgung lo lnga bcu pa la rgya gar du phebs/ mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi/ ye shes mkha' 'gro rnam pa gnyis sogs las theg pa che chung thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing de dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rdzogs par thob pa las/ thog mar khyad 'phags bla ma rnam bzhi'i ya gyal rdo rje gdan pa puṇ+yā ka ra gup+ta dang mjal ba'i tshul mgur du bzhengs pa/ kho bo khyung po rnal 'byor gyis/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma bzod par/ / 'jigs skrag chen po gting nas skyes/ /'khor ba mtha' med 'di 'dra ba/ /skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med/ /ngan song sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab/ / 'chi bas mi 'jigs skye bas 'jigs/ /skye ba las kyi rjes su 'brangs/ /rang dbang med par 'khor bar 'khyams/ /bdag dang sems can thams cad kyang*/ / cis kyang mi phan 'chi ngo shes/ /nam yang 'chi ba 'di 'dra la/ /chos phyir srog ni btang snyam nas/ /lus dang srog la ma bltas te/ /bal yul tsam la ma bltos par/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'byung gnas sa/ /ston pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rdo rje gdan du tshangs kyis phyin/ /rgyal ba thub pa chen po yis/ /sangs rgyas gnyis par lung bstan pa'i/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /dngos su zhal mjal dkon pa yi/

/gu lang gser srang lnga brgya phul/ /sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal snyam nas/ /ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrugs/ /mos gus chen po gting nas skye/ /gus pas thal sbyar 'di skad zhus/ /bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge slong gi /mkhan po mdzad nas 'dul ba zhu/ /byang chub chen por sems bskyed nas// theg pa chen po'i chos rnams zhu/ /smin byed gsang sngags dbang bskur nas/ / grol bar byed pa'i bskyed rdzogs zhu/ /de skad bdag gi gsol btab pas/ / dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa yis/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan 'di skad gsungs/ / srin po gdong dmar mtha' 'khob yul/ /log ltas rgyud dkrugs the tshom can// sna tshogs chos tshol sgrub mi nus/ /rang ma smin par gzhan don byed/ /gcig la gcig smra phrag dog can/ /mi nag chos kyi lo rgyus mkhan/ /de lta bu yi rgyal khams na/ /dad ldan skye 'chis 'jigs pa yi/ /snying stobs ldan pa'i skyes bu khyod/ /ma nor dam chos tshol ba'i phyir/ /srog la mi phongs dka' spyad nas/ /rgya gar yul rnams bgrod byed pa'i/ /skal ldan khyung po rnal 'byor khyod/ /sngon tshe byang phyogs gangs can du/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul dpag med ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po zhes byar gyur/ /de tshe log lta mu stegs dang*/ /lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung po dang*/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams 'dul bar byed/ khyod ni nyan thos tshogs bskor nas/ /mkha' la bya bzhin rnam par rgyu/ /ri dang chu la thogs med cing*/ /gcig dang du mar snang ba sogs/ /sprul pa sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba'i/ /dgra bcom chen po nyid gyur pas/ /bdag dang rgya gar mkhas rnams kyis/ khyed kyi mkhan po byed mi nus/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs su/ /glang ri 'od ldan gser mdog can/ /sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi/ /sprul pa bzhugs kyi der song la/ /bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po zhus/ /yul dbus ma ga rdo rje gdan/ /gnas mchog 'di dang gzhan rnams su/

khyod kyis ji skad zhus pa yi// 'dul ba phar phyin gsang sngags rnams/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin bstan par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs nas dge tshul gyi mkhan po mdzad/ mtshan tshul khrims mgon du gsol bas bla ma rdo rje gdan pa shangs khrag shor nas/ khyung po rnal 'byor las spo ma nus so/ /de'i dus su bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyung po dzo ki ma hā pha la pha la gsungs nas/ thog mar 'dul ba lung dang*/ bstan bcos mdo rtsa gsungs/ de nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung gdams thams cad rim par gnang*/ thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa rin chen rgya mtsho'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams la brten pa'i rgyud sde lnga dkyil 'khor gcig tu sgrub pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag gsan pa'i tshul yang 'di ltar gsungs so/ /de la rgyud sde chen po lnga'i/ /dbang dang rgyud dang sgrub pa'i thabs/ / gdams pa'i mchog gi khyad par ni/ /bde ba mchog gi grol rgyud las/ /rgyu lam 'bras bu bstan pa yang*/ /bde ba chen po grub pas na/ /byang chub sems kyi rdo rje ni/ /bde ba sgrub pa nyid yin te/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang*// snying po ma hā mā yā dang*/ /yang snying dgyes pa rdo rje dang*/ /dga' chen za nus sgyu 'phrul che/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ /drag po rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams/ /mthar thug ston pa lnga po la/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi rgyud/ /

zung du 'jug pa nyid yin pas/ /dang po smin lam dbang la yang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba nyid yin no/ /lam la rim pa gnyis yin te/ /bskyed rim dang ni rdzogs rim mo/ /bskyed pa snang dang rdzogs pa stong*/ /dbyer med zung 'jug chu zla bzhin/ /rdzogs pa rang lus gzhan lus dang*/ /zung 'jug bde stong dbyer med do/ /'bras bu mchog dang thun mong ngo*/ /thun mong las brgyad grub chen brgyad/ /mchog la sku bzhi mdzad par bcas/ /lhun grub gang 'dul rang shar ro/ /gang zag sbyangs pa'i las can gyis/ /rtse gcig ma yengs 'bad gyur na/ / dam tshig ldan pas nges par thob/ /rang lus thabs ldan lam dang ni/ /gzhan lus las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /'dod yon lam khyer gnad mchog 'di/ /brgyud pa mchog gi rim pa yang*/ /sangs rgyas lung bstan thob pa yi/ /slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ /'od gsal bsten pas grub pa brnyes/ /kaṃ pa la zhes bya ba dang/ /phyag rgya khyi ru sprul byed pa'i/ /ku ku ri pa chen po dang*/ /nya lto gsol zhing grub pa thob/ /lo hi pa zhes grags pa dang*/ /lhag pa'i lha yis byin rlabs pa/ /dpal 'dzin ha ri ke la dang*/ /de dag rnams las rim brgyud pa/ / ḍom+bhi pa dang ku su lu/ /ma hā badz+ras legs bsdus te/ /dpal ldan ye shes sde zhes pa/ /bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ /su ma ti zhes rnal 'byor dang*/ /ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ /a mo gha ni badz+ra dang*/ /dpal ldan rdo rje gdan pa rnams/ /rim gyis bdag la brgyud pa'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de nas rje btsun shrīdz+nyā na dang*/ bai ro tsa na rak+ṣi ta/ ḍā ki ma ka na ka shrī sogs las mdo dang mtshan nyid/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud sgrub thabs gdams ngag dpag tu med pa zhus shing bod du phebs khar ri ma la ya'i rtser bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la gser srang bcu gsum phul nas tshes bcu'i mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe ltas dang lung bstan byung ba'i tshul gyi tshigs bcad 'di gsungs so/

/mkha' las me tog char bzhin babs/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bar snang khengs/ /sgra dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon 'khrugs /lha rnams mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshe/ /rdo rje gdan pas 'di skad gsungs/ /rigs kyi bu khyod bod du song*/ / gdul bya kha ba can ljongs kyi/ /sems can mang po grol byed cing*/ /phyi ma'i tshe na chos 'di rnams/ khyod kyis rgyud 'dzin rnal 'byor pa/ /gcig gis dar bar byed par 'gyur/ /chos 'di rnams kyi bka' thob cing*/ /phan sems ldan pa de yis ni/ /gang byung rgyal sras ma nor ston/ /rab tu mi gnas sa la sbyor/ /rim gyis don rtogs mang du 'byung*/ /grub mtha' gzhung chen bzhi nyid las/ /mtshan nyid theg dang rdo rje theg /khyad par rnam par 'byed pa yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i lam byed pa/ /mngon sum rjes dpag rim pa yis/ /gtan tshigs chen po bzhi la ni/ /mtshan nyid gsum gyis gtan la 'bebs/ /de ni rtsod pa'i lam rim mo/ /pha rol phyin dang gsang ba sngags/ /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ / thun mong lam lnga khyad par gnyis/ /zhar spyad don bsdus lam byed pa/ /sgrub pa'i rim pa zhes bya'o/ /de dag lam rim gnyis pa'o/ /de nyid mthong lam zhes bya dang*/ /lta ba ngan pas ma gos pa'i/ /ye shes mngon du byed pa'i lam/ / mtha' dang bral ba'i lam nyid ni/ /zung du 'jug par ston pa dang*/ /dbu ma chen po nyid du 'jug /zhi gnas lhag mthong ting nge 'dzin/ /gong nas gong du lam sbyong ba/ /sems kyi lam mchog zhes byar bstan/ /nga dang 'dra bar khyod kyis rtogs/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan bdag gis thob/ khyod kyang 'di nas sangs rgyas shing*/ /bde ba can du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rtsod ldan gdul dka'i sems can la/ /skyo ba ma byed byang sems sgoms/ /bde mchog rang byon dkyil 'khor gyi/ /sa ru gdul bya khri phrag 'byung*/ /zhes lung bstan to/ /de nas bod yul du byon nas 'gro don thog gcig mdzad gu lang gi gser kha brdol ba thug nas gser mang po phyag tu 'byor pa bsnams nas slar yang bal po dang rgya gar du gshegs te rdo rje gdan pa dang*/

rgyal ba mai tri pa dang/ dha byang chub sems dpa'/ rje btsun rin chen lha mo/ su ma ti kīrti/ bal po pham mthing pa chen po sogs mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pa du ma las sngar ma gsan pa'i zab chos dang myur mdzad ye shes mgon po'i skor sogs gdams ngag dpag tu med pa gsan/ de dag gis thugs ma tshims par gser srang lnga brgya khyer nas rgya gar shar nub lho byang kun tu rgyu zhing*/ grub thob kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dngos mjal ba su yod dris pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang grub thob rnams mthun par/ na ro paṇ+ḍi ta yi lcam mo ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu ma zhes bya ba dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa rdo rje 'chang chen po la dngos su chos zhu nus pa gcig yod zer bas/ de gnas gang na bzhugs byas pas/ snang ba dag na gar yang zhal mthong*/ snang ba ma dag na gar yang btsal bas mi rnyed de dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dang*/ 'ja' lus su gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang dur khrod chen po so sa gling gi nags gseb na/ ḍā ki ma'i tshogs 'khor gyi dpon la res 'ga' 'byon zer bas/ ḍā ki ma'i mtshan thos pa tsam gyis mchi ma 'khrug cing ba spu ldang ba'i mos gus skyes nas/ dus der dur khrod so sa gling gi nags gseb nas yar la/ na mo bud+dha'i gsol ba 'debs kyin phyin pa dang/ shing tā la bdun srid tsam gyi nam mkha' la mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog smug nag tu yod pa/ rus pas brgyan pa phyag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa bsnams pa gcig dang du ma la sogs pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston cing*/ gar bsgyur ba mthong nas 'di ḍā ki ni gu ma yin par 'dug snyam nas phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba du ma byas nas/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhu 'tshal byas pas nga shā za'i ḍā ki ma yin/ nga'i 'khor rnams byung na zar 'ongs pas myur bar bros shig gsungs so/ /de nas yang phyag dang bskor ba byas nas gsang sngags kyi gdams pa zhu byas pas/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags zhu ba la gser dgos pa yin/

gser yod na bya yi gsungs nas/ gser srang lnga brgya phul ba dang*/ nags gseb tu gtor ro/ / der 'dir nges par sha za'i mkha' 'gro ma yin nam gser la yang phongs pa mi 'dug snyam pa dang/ mkha' 'gro ma des spyan nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa dang*/ 'khor ḍā ki ma dpag tu med pa nam mkha' las byung ste/ 'ga' zhig gis gzhal yas khang sum rim skad cig la bzhengs/ 'ga' zhig gis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ 'ga' zhig gis tshogs kyi yo byad bsags nas/ tshes bco lnga'i nam srod la sgyu lus rmi lam gyi dbang bskur mdzad nas dbang thon pa dang bod kyi ban chung yar 'dong dang gsungs nas/ dpag tshad gsum ḍā ki ma'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas yud tsam gyis bgrod pa dang*/ gser gyi ri mi che ba tsam gcig gi steng gi nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas gar bsgyur zhing 'dug go /ri de'i phyogs bzhi nas mar gser gyi chu rgyun bzhi 'bab cing 'dug nas/ gser gyi ri 'di lta bu rgya gar na yod dam/ mkha' 'gro mas sprul pa yin zhus pas 'di gsungs so/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bsgyur ba yi/ /chags sdang rtog pa sna tshogs 'di/ / rang bzhin med par rtogs tsam na/ /thams cad gser gling yin no bu/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams la/ /sgyu ma lta bur bsgom byas na/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgya/ /mos gus stobs las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ces gsungs nas rgyud sde lnga'i dbang dang rgyud sgrub thabs gdams ngag dpag tu med pa dang*/ khyad par chos drug gi khrid rmi lam du lan gcig /dngos su lan gsum gnang nas brgyud pa bdun gyi bar du chig brgyud kyi rgyas btab/ de nas kyang rim par byin gyis brlabs shing lung bstan par zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas slar yang gser srang lnga brgya khyer nas rgya gar nub phyogs su phyin te/ sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal ba'i bla ma su yod dris pas/

paṇ+ḍi ta rol ba'i rdo rje dang*/ ār+ya de ba dang*/ ḍā ki ma su ma ti la sogs pa grub thob bcu gsum gyi zhal nas/ nged rnams kyis dbang bskur la gdams ngag bstan nas de'i rjes la lung ston par 'gyur ro gsungs pas/ gser srang lnga brgya phul nas dbang dang gdams pa mang po zhus so/ khong rnams kyi zhal nas nged bcu po 'di yi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin/ khyad par du paṇ+ḍi ta ār+ya de ba la bdag med ma'i nang khrid bstan pas zla ba bdun la sa brgyad kyi rtogs pa la 'god pa'i ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma su kha sid+dhi zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang dang bdag med ma las dngos su chos gsan pa gcig yod kyi/ des khyod la byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pa ston par 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan to/ /de gang du bzhugs zhus pas/ ḍā ki ma de snang ba dag na gar yang zhal mthong la/ snang ba ma dag na btsal bas mi rnyed de/ res 'ga' ni bde ba sbyin pa'i gnas tsan+dan sman gyi nags tshal zhes bya bar tshes bcu'i dus su ḍā ki ma rnams kyi tshogs dpon mdzad cing chos ston pa dang*/ yang na gsung gi sgo nas chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /der song la gsol ba thob cig /dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur nas gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mtha' dag ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas gser srang lnga brgya po de khyer nas/ bde ba sbyin pa'i nags gseb nas yar la na mo bud+dha ya'i gsol ba 'debs shing phyin pa na/ tsan+dan gyi nags de'i steng gi nam mkha' la ḍā ki ma sku mdog dkar mo dbu skra sil bus sku rgyab non pa/ phyag gnyis skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ḍā ki ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa mthong ngo*/ /de mthong ba dang lus la ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrugs la/ sa dang po lta bu'i dga' ba skyes nas zag med kyi bde ba'i nyams dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas me tog ut+pal dang*/

pad+ma dang*/ ku mu ta la sogs pa mang po gtor nas phyag dang bskor ba brgya stong du ma byas te gdams ngag zhu 'tshal byas pas/ ḍā ki ma'i zhal nas 'di gsungs so/ /bir+wa pa dang bdag med ma/ / rdo rje 'chang las dngos su thos/ /gsang sngags mngon sum lam pa yi/ /smin par byed pa'i dbang bzhi dang*/ /grol ba'i bskyed rdzogs ston pa la/ /dkon pa'i rin chen gser phye phul/ /gus pa'i thal sbyor rkyang phyag 'tshol/ /dma' ba'i zhabs mthil gtsug gis longs/ /dus 'dir bdag gis grol bar bya/ / de ring rnyed pa mchog rnyed do/ /rigs kyi bu khyod e ma ho/ /rigs kyi bu khyod e ma ho/ /rigs kyi bu khyod he ma ho/ khyod kyi slob ma yang slob dang*/ /phyi rabs brgyud 'dzin thams cad la/ /nga yis dngos su byin gyis rlobs/ /dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro /zhes gsungs nas/ dang po sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur nas gsang sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi bskyed rdzogs nyams len gyi gnad dang bcas pa thams cad ma lus par gsungs so// de la ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma su kha sid+dhi 'di dang po drin che ste/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur/ bar du drin che ste lha'i bu mo dang dbyer med du gsang yum mdzad/ mtha' mar drin che ste gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ bdag nyid bde ba can du bcu bzhi'i sa thob par lung bstan/ slob ma yang slob brgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa thams cad la thugs rjes bzung nas/ dag pa bde stong gi mkha' spyod du 'gro bar lung bstan par mdzad do/ /des na bdag gi brgyud 'dzin thams cad kyang kun las khyad par 'phags pas na/ bsags pa yang rab 'ba' zhig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'ang gsungs so/ /de nas kun tu bzang mo sogs mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rnams dang*/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ rol ba'i rdo rje/ a ta ya badz+ra sogs mkhas grub rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtha' yas pa rnams las rgyud dang gdams ngag gi spros pa bcad cing gser gyi me tog gis mnyes par mdzad/

rdo rje gdan du dus mchod chen po mdzad pa'i tshe ngo mtshar gyi ltas rgya chen po byung bas 'phags yul pa mchog dman mtha' dag mgrin gcig tu bsngags pa brjod/ bod yul du sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam 'phrul dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad nas 'phan yul 'jog po rir thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i skabs/ 'chi med grub pa rā hu la gup+ta rdzu 'phrul gyis phebs te gdams ngag mtha' yas pa gnang ba las/ phran tshegs nyer mkho'i man ngag rnam pa brgyad dgos pa'i dbang gis phyis tshogs gral zhig la mgur du bzhengs pa ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog 'di tho co che/ /thim pa rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bdog /gzung 'dzin gyi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed gzung 'dzin kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /lha chen dpe dkar 'di tho co che/ /thi gu rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bdog /lha chen gyi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed lha chen kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /klu bdud nag po 'di tho co che/ / thod pa kha sbyor gyi gdams pa bdog /klu bdud kyi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed klu bdud kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /mtshan mo'i 'byung po 'di tho co che/ /bdud rtsi thig le'i gdams pa bdog /'byung po'i g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed 'byung po kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /byad stems nag po 'di tho co che/ /rdo leb nag po'i gdams pa bdog /byad stems kyi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed byad stems kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ /'chi bdag nag po 'di tho co che/ /keng rus tar yi gdams pa bdog /'chi bdag gi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed 'chi bdag kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ / gza' bdud nag po 'di tho co che/ /rus sbal 'khor lo'i gdams pa bdog/ gza' bdud kyi g.yul ngo de nas bzlog /khyed khyab 'jug kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/

/sngar ngag la byin gyis ma brlabs pas/ /sngags bzlas pa rnams la nus ma byung*/ /dpal ā li kā li'i gdams pa bdog /sngags mi 'grub snyam pa'i dogs pa med/ /ces so/ /de nas dpon slob sum stong gis shangs su byon te zhang zhong gis sna drangs pa'i dgon gnas brgya dang rtsa brgyad lo gsum gyi nang du btab/ chos kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor ba la dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa khri tsho lnga 'dus pa'i dus su phal cher g.yeng ba shas che bas nyan bshad dang sgom sgrub la g.yel ba'i dus su/ thams cad ltad mo la khrid nas sum cu rtsa gsum lha dang lha mo mang po'i rtsed 'jo sprul nas bstan pas dga' zhing chags/ yang gshin rje'i skyes bu 'jigs su rung ba du mas gsod gcod kyi las byed par sprul pas sngangs skrag brgyal bar gyur pa'i tshe ngo sprod kyi mgur du bzhengs pa ni/ chags sdang yul rnams thams cad kyang*/ /rang gi sems las byung ba ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi snang ba la/ /sha za la sogs gshin rje'i gzugs/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs lag na thogs/ /tshe srog dus 'dir sdang byed kyang*/ /sgyu mar shes pas grol bar 'gyur/ /lha mo mdzes ma rgyan gyis brgyan/ /glu len snyan pa'i sgra sgrog cing*//

yid 'ong mang pos mtha' bskor yang*/ /rang snang sgyu mar thag chod na/ /de dag gis kyang 'ching mi nus/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i chos dang*/ bar do'i chos bstan pas thams cad nyan bshad dang*/ sgom sgrub la brtson par gyur to/ /lan gcig rong po dge bshes dkon mchog rgyal gyis 'bul ba chen po phul nas khyed rgya gar du lan gsum byon/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam bzhi sogs mkhas grub brgya dang lnga bcu bsten nas grub thob tu gyur nas snang ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa yin zer bas/ brag 'di la phar thal tshur thal 'ga' re gyis la/ nam mkha' la skyil krung gyis la 'dug dang zer ba la/ brag ri de la zang thal du phyin/ nam mkha' la skyil krung bcas nas gcig dang du mar snang ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul 'ga' re bstan pas/ rong po dang grā pa thams cad shin tu dad de/ de lta bu'i yon tan de gdams ngag gang bsgoms pa las byung ba yin zer ba la 'di gsungs so/ /chos rnams sgyu ma lta bu la/ /sgyu ma lta bur nyams blangs pas/ /sgyu ma lta bur mngon sangs rgyas/ /snang yang bden med chos rnams la/ /byis pas bden par bzung bas 'khrul/ /med bzhin snang ba e ma ho/ /la sogs pa'i chos bshad pas dad de zla ba bcu gcig na rong pos yi dam lha'i zhal mthong nas snang ba bden med du rtogs so/ /yang nye gnas rin chen rdo rjes tha mal rang rgyud bzung nas log lta cung zad re shor ba mkhyen nas yi ge brgya pa dang dag byed a'i stong ra zhag bdun sgom du bcug nas gzim chung du byung ba dang*/ sku lus dgyes rdor mtshon cha can lha bcu gsum du sprul nas bstan pas der mthong*/ yang gnas lngar rgyud sde lnga'i dkyil 'khor bkod pas kyang ji lta bar mthong*/ phyir song bas chos khri brgya rtsa brgyad du chos bstan pa mthong nas ched du brjod pa/ sku lus sprul pa'i lha dgu la/ /gnas lngar rgyud sde lnga yi lha/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi chos khri la/

/blta bas mi ngoms sku lus re/ /mtha' bral theg chen chos sgra sgrog /sna tshogs sprul pa phyogs bcur ston/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs sprul pa'i/ /bla ma sangs rgyas khyed la bstod/ /ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams/ /yang dag lam la gzung du gsol/ /zhes khos bstod pa byas so/ /de nas log lta skad cig ma skyes par/ ci gsungs nyan pa'i nye gnas su gyur to/ / skabs shig byams pa'i chos lnga dang/ gsang ba spyi rgyud bshad pa'i 'tsho ba 'dren pa la/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa rnams ma 'chams par/ dam sel du 'gro bar byung ba dang/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams byung nas 'di skad zhus so/ /thar med gnas su skye ba dang*/ /thar pa'i gnas gcod byed pa ni/ /mi mthun dag las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de phyir dam tshig smos ci dgos/ / mthun pa'i dka' thub dag la ni/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas rnyed mi dka'/ /de phyir 'dir tshogs lha rnams kyis/ /chos gsungs tshe na bsnyen bkur bya/ /ta la bdun srid gcig kyang rung*/ /mkha' la chos char dbab tu gsol/ /chos kyi dung chen bsgrag tu gsol/ /chos kyi ba dan bsgreng du gsol/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ /zla ba bdun mi zas mi za bar dam bcas nas nam mkha' la shing ta la gcig gi tshad tsam la bzhugs te zla ba bdun gyi bar du byams pa'i chos lnga dang*/ gsang ba spyi rgyud tshar bar byas pas/ dbu ma'i lta ba khong du chud pa mang du byung ba dang*/ lha rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces brjod par gyur to/ /bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur to/ /lha rnams tshims par gyur to/ /mi rnams grol bar gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bya ba chen po byas par gyur to/ /a la la zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ me tog gi char chen po phab ste mi snang bar gyur to/ /lan gcig sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis bde chen zhing gi bkod pa rnams bstan nas 'di skad gsungs so/

/ khyod kyi skye ba mtha' ma ste/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /sde dang bcas pa'i bdud btul nas/ /mngon par byang chub 'khor lo bskor/ /gang gis khyod kyi rjes slob cing*/ /'od dpag mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*/ /bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /rdzu 'phrul chen pos skye bar 'gyur/ khyod kyi brgyud 'dzin rnam pa gsum/ /mngon dga' dang ni bde ba can/ /dag pa'i zhing nas zhing du 'gro / der ni mngon par byang chub 'gyur/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i lung bstan mang du mdzad do/ /yang thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi 'od zer las chos kyi sgra gsan pa ni/ chos rnams rang bzhin skye med las/ /'gag med snying rje ma shar na/ /'gro drug sems can ma rgan rnams/ /smin cing grol bar mi nus pas/ / 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du/ /ma yi drin dang sdug bsngal rnams/ /ma yengs dran pa'i lcags kyus zungs/ /tshad med snying rje chen po bskyed/ /byams pa'i gangs ri chen po las/ /snying rje'i chu rgyun bsil ba yis/ /nyon mongs me dpung zhi bar mdzod/ /nga ni snying rje chen po'i sku/ /zhes sogs snying rje mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin gsungs so/ /yang u rgyan tu phebs nas rje btsun ma lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhus pa dang*/ ḍā ki ma seng ge'i gdong pa can la ḍā ki ma sde bzhis bskor nas rdo rje'i glu 'di ltar blangs so/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gros bar chad srung*/ /rin chen mkha' 'gros mi nor spel/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gros bud med sdud/ /'phrin las mkha' 'gros las kun sgrub/ /'dod sred chags pa'i dbang song bas/ /bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i dbang du song*/ /phyi rol mi 'dod gang yang 'byung*/ /ḍā ki rang gi sems su shes/ /sems kyi de nyid shes pa dang*/ /sems nyid mi rtog rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje ḍā kis bar chad srung*/ /chog shes dgos med rin chen gter/ /rin chen mkha' 'gros dgos 'dod sgrub/

/ chags bral mi rtog pad+ma ste/ /pad+ma ḍā kis mu dra sdud/ /skye 'gag med pa karma sde// las kyi ḍā kis 'phrin las sgrub/ /de ltar ma shes rnal 'byor pas/ /bskal bar bsgrubs kyang 'grub mi 'gyur/ /de phyir mkha' 'gro rang sems su/ /shes pa gnad kyi mchog yin no/ /zhes pa la sogs 'char ba rnam pa gsum dang*// 'du ba rnam gsum gyi gdams ngag rnams gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis lung bstan pa ltar tshogs pa'i mthar thug khri tsho brgyad la lo du mar chos bstan/ slob ma'i mthar thug drug po la gdams ngag ma lus pa tshar/ sku tshe'i mthar thug brgya dang lnga bcu la babs nas/ zhing khams mthar thug bde ba can du gshegs par dgongs pa'i tshe rgyal chen bzhi dang klu rgyal ma dros pa/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa sogs lha klu mi min dpag tu med pa 'dus/ mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod cing mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba btab pa la bka' bstsal pa ni/ bla ma yi dam lung bstan pa'i/ /mthar thug gsum gyi dus la babs/ /da ni zhing khams mthar thug pa'i/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro /dag pa'i longs spyod dpag tu med/ /'jig rten gser dngul dgos pa med/ khyed rnams nga la dad gyur na/ /bde ba can du gsol ba thob/ /zhing der skye bar the tshom med/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed zhing*/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rdzogs par snang*/ /zhing dag ston pa 'khor dang chos/ /dpag tu med pa 'od dpag zhing*/ /rnam par dag pa bde ba can/ /de phyir the tshom ma byed par/ /zhing der skye ba'i smon lam thob/ / zhes pa la sogs pa'i chos bshad nas tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas tshes bcu bzhi la tshogs su phebs te nam mkha' la sku lus kyi bkod pa mang po bstan te 'di skad gsungs so/ /kye ma 'dus byas mi rtag ste/ /nam mkha'i sprin bzhin 'dus shing gyes// bden med sgyu ma'i chos rnams la/

/bden par bzung bas bslus pa yin/ /nga yi lus ni rgyal ba'i sku/ /skye 'chi can du ma lta zhig /nga yi ngag ni rgyal ba'i gsung*/ /brjod bral skye med rang sgra sgrog /nga yi sems ni rgyal ba'i thugs/ / rtogs bral mkhyen pa'i ye shes ldan/ /ces gsungs pa dang*/ nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' dang rol mo'i sgras gang zhing me tog gi char chen po bab par gyur to/ /mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gdams ngag yongs su rdzogs pa'i thugs sras chen po rnam pa drug gi ya gyal gcig brgyud kyi bka' babs 'dzin pa'i phyi bu gcig pu ba/ rmog lcog pa rin chen brtson 'grus zhes bya ba sku tshe de nyid brjes ma thag par shar phyogs 'od 'phro can gyi zhing khams su mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de nyid/ tha snyad bshad pa'i chos la snying po med par gzigs nas/ khams pa a seng dang*/ bur sgom nag po sogs grub thob kyi bla ma gdams ngag che tshad la gtugs shing nyams len mdzad kyang thugs dam mthar phyin pa ma byung*/ re zhig gi tshe mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis rjes su bzung ste gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang*/ dang por sdings mar lo gnyis bsgoms pas sgyu lus rmi lam 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa 'khrungs/ shangs pa sku gshegs pas bla ma dwags po lha rje'i spyan sngar dge sbyor dogs gcod la byon pas skye ba du ma'i dpon slob yin gsungs nas shin tu dgyes pas gdams ngag mang po gnang*/ der phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba la sgro 'dogs chod/ nyams rtogs kyi rtsal phyogs med du rgyas/ rmi lam sprul bsgyur gyi skabs su rdo rje'i mgur 'di gsungs so/ /skye med klong nas 'gags med 'phyo/ /bsam pa tsam gyis thogs pa med/ /gang gis bslur med sgyu ma'i lus/ /rnal 'byor rig pa'i klong nas shar/

/tshe 'di'i rnam rtog yal nas thal/ /rnam smin gyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ / ngo sprod kyi rje btsun rin po che/ /yid kyi lus la chos kyi sku/ /ngo sprod kyi rje btsun rin po che/ /bag chags kyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /ngo sprod kyi rje btsun rin po che/ /zhes bya ba la sogs gsungs shing de nas bzung tshe 'di'i rnam rtog skye ma myong gsungs so/ /de nas bla ma rnams kyi gsung bzhin ri dang ma bral bar byas nas yang na shi ba dang yang na sangs rgya ba gcig la gtad dgos dgongs nas rmog lcog gi brag tu gsol zas nyungs ma tsam la brten nas lo bcu gnyis su bzhugs pa'i tshe su kha sid+dhi byon nas 'di gsungs so/ /chos nyid mngon du ma gyur tshe/ /mi zas 'tsho bas nyams myong 'grib/ / lto gos 'khri ba bcad nas kyang*/ /rnam rtog ting 'dzin zas su zo/ /ces lan gsum gsungs pas lto gos 'khri ba chod/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'khrungs/ de rnams kyi tshe rdo rje'i mgur mang du bzhengs pa las rgyal srid sna bdun rang la tshang ba'i mgur ni/ las su dgra btul gnyen bskyangs kyang*/ / dgra la thub pa'i dus kyang med/ /gnyen la mgu ba'i dus kyang med/ /da dgra med gnyen med byed las che/ /las su lha brten 'dre bskrad kyang*/ /lha la mgu ba'i dus kyang med/ /'dre la 'gro ba'i dus kyang med/ /lha med 'dre med byed las che/ /stong pa nyid kyi rjes 'brang yang*/ /stong nyid kyi lta la thug mtha' med// gcig pu rtsa ba gcod las che/ /mi chos kyi phyogs kyi tha ma la/ /lha chos kyi phyogs su rab gcig byung*/ /yang dag don la mi lta bar/ /ched du sgyu ma'i nor 'tshol 'khrul/ /sems la gang phan mi lta bar/ /tha snyad tshig phyir 'brangs te 'khrul/ /dman pa'i cha lugs mi 'dzin par/ /che btsun gyi 'gying ra byas las che/ /phyogs med ldom bu mi byed par/ /lung stong gi grog tshang bshig ste 'khrul//

gcig pur nyams su mi len par/ /mang po'i dpon po byas las che/ /dal 'byor mi lus khe ldan 'di/ /don med phyal bar zad du phangs/ /rang sems nor bu rin chen 'di/ /'khor ba'i 'dam du bying du phangs/ /bla ma'i gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /g.yeng ba'i dbang du btang ste phangs/ /zung 'jug gsal ba'i sgron me 'di/ /rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod du phangs/ /spyod pa ro snyoms bde chen 'di/ /chos brgyad bdud kyis non du phangs/ /rang lus rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'di/ /tha mal las la bkol du phangs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi bde skyid 'di/ /tshogs drug gi snang ba grogs su shar/ /'khor 'das la nyam nga ma mchis pas/ /rang sems rgyal po yin no sems/ /rang sems rtogs pa'i rgyal po la// rin chen bdun gyi rgyan yang thogs/ /bdag tha snyad kyi tshig phyir mi 'brangs par/ /zab mo'i don la mos par byas/ /nges shes blo yi gting nas skyes/ /de blon po gros kyi phul du byung*/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhal snga nas/ /gdams ngag zab mo de rang ston/ /rje nā ro pa yi bu brgyud la/ /rgyud lung sgrog 'dogs chod cig gsungs/ /man ngag che dgu btus btus nas/ /'khor 'das kyi rtsa ba bcad lags pas/ /ma rig pa skye med du yal nas thal/ /rta mchog gis dug lnga dbyings su bskyal/ /lar mang po 'tshogs pa'i 'du 'dzi 'di/ /g.yeng bar 'dug pas ri khrod 'grims/ /bskyed rdzogs gnyis la gzhi byas nas/ /rang gi sems kyi rtsal yang sbyangs/ khyung phrug mkha' la gshegs dang 'dra/ /de gar 'gyur 'khor lo rin po che/ /tshogs drug gi snang ba had por thal/ /de lta'i don la chog shes pas/ /longs spyod che la dga' rgyu med/ /bstod smad tshig gis snyan sdug med/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi cho 'phrul yang*/ /rang snang yin pas 'jigs rgyu med/ /sems nyid rtag chad gnyis dang bral/ /skye shi gnyis la skrag rgyu med/ /de dmag dpon gyis log rtog choms sam sems/

/de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /sems nyid gdod nas dag pa la/ /snang ba slob dpon du 'char gyin gda'/ /de glang pos dmag dpung bskyod dang 'dra/ /zhe 'dod dran med ngang yal thal/ /mkha' la bya 'phur rten ma mchis/ /tshogs drug skyes na glo bur ba/ /'dzin pa med par grogs su shar/ /bkag pa med par gzigs mor che/ /de btsun mo mdzes ma'i brgyan yang btags/ /de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ khyab pa nam mkha' lta bu la/ /sems kyi khyim la yangs dog med/ /ngos gzung med 'dra'i bar snang la/ /'od gsal sgo la yangs dog med// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med pas/ /sku gsum gyi rgyun la yangs dog med/ / 'bad med nyi ma lta bu la/ /nyi zer 'char ba phyogs ris med/ /de nor bus dgos 'dod re ba skong*/ /rin chen bdun gyi nor mchog 'di/ /rnal 'byor pa yi rgyan du che/ /lus dang bral yang 'di mi 'bral/ /nor gyi dam pa yin nam sems/ /rgyal po'i longs spyod la smon rgyu med/ /mkhas pa'i tha snyad la dga' rgyu med/ /de shob be yin na 'gum pa lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang nyams myong blo drug gi mgur ni/ dang por sgro 'dogs chod nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su the tshom byung*/ /lta bas kyang rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ / da spros bral gyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /dang po skye med rtogs nas kyang*//

da rung skabs su snyems byed byung*/ /bsgoms pas kyang rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ /da ma yengs sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /dang po 'dzin med du byas nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su chags zhen byung*/ /spyod pas kyang rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ /da 'dzin med kyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /dang por rtse gcig tu gnas nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su re dogs byung*/ /'bras bus kyang rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ /da lhun grub kyi sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /dang por thod rgal byung nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su nyam nga byung*/ /chos brgyad kyis rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ /da smyon pa'i sems dang mi 'bral 'tshal/ /dang por gnyen 'dun spangs nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su ngo srung byung*/ /da yang ngo srung mi bgyid 'tshal/ /dang por dad pa skyes nas kyang*/ /da rung skabs su btang snyoms byung*/ /le los kyang rnal 'byor bslu bslu 'dra/ /nga brtson 'grus dang rnal 'byor mi 'bral 'tshal/ /lha gcig dkon mchog gsum po la/ /dad gus kyi skyo ngal mi bgyid 'tshal/ /pha gcig bla ma dam pa la/ /mos gus rgyun chad med par 'tshal/ /gdams ngag gzugs kyi nying khu la/ /tshig tshogs kyi lhad kyis ma bslad 'tshal/ /lar mkhas pa bas kyang sgrub pa gces/ /gcig pur sdod la nyams su longs/ /'khor ba'i skyon gyis sun phyung la/ /chos mya ngan 'das la mos pa dka'/ /rgyu 'bras chos la yid ches nas/ /skyo ngal med pa'i dad pa dka'/ /na ba tsha ba kun spangs nas/ /bkol du btub pa'i mi lus dka'/ /lung rig man ngag dang ldan pa'i/ /thugs rje can gyi bla ma dka'/ / 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba kun spangs nas/ /nyams su len pa'i slob ma dka'/ / chags sdang zhe sdang kun spangs nas/ /gzhan don byed pa'i snying rje dka'/ / gzung 'dzin rnam rtog dang bral ba'i/ /rtse gcig gnas pa'i bsam gtan dka'/ /dka' ba rnam brgyad gdams ngag 'di/ /chos byed rnams la 'di tsho gces/

/'di tsho 'dzom pa rgya la 'ga'/ /de phyir byang chub thob par dka'/ /nga sgro 'dogs sems la chod pa la/ /mtha' bral gyi lta ba mi zer ram/ /de lung rigs dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /rnam rtog chos skur shar ba la/ /rang byung sgom pa mi zer ram/ /de nyams myong dang 'brel ba gnad du che/ /tshogs drug rang sar grol ba la/ /chags med kyi spyod pa mi zer ram/ /dus tshod dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /stong nyid kyi nyams myong dang 'brel ba la/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mi zer ram/ /de dbang dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /stong nyid kyi gsal snang skye ba la/ /sa lam kyi rim pa mi zer ram/ /de lam rtags dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /rang sems zad sar bskyal ba la/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas mi zer ram/ / de sku bzhi dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /mtshan nyid gsum ldan gyi gang zag la/ / brgyud ldan gyi bla ma mi zer ram/ /de gdams ngag dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ / dad ldan shes rab che ba la/ /snod ldan gyi slob ma mi zer ram/ /de mos gus dang 'brel ba rgyan du che/ /bla ma rin chen gyi ri bo la/ /gdams ngag dam pa'i chu mig bdog /dad pa skyo ngal med pas 'thung nus na/ /nyes skyon kun las thar par nges/ /'dus byas lus kyi bum nang na/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron me bdog /ting nge 'dzin thob pas chog shes na/ /phyi nang chos skur gsal bar nges/ /rang lus sgyu ma'i ri bo la/ /rnam par shes pa'i seng phrug rtse/ /tshogs drug zhen med du sbyong shes na/ /'khor 'das zil gyis non pa nges/ /ma rig pa yi tshang nang na/ /rnam par shes pa'i khyung phrug bdog /thabs shes kyi gshog pa sbyor nus na/ /'gro drug mkha' la 'phur bar nges/ /blo blo phyi yi yul la ltos/ / phyi yi yul la bltas tsam na/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang la rang bzhin med par gda'o/ /blo blo nang gi sems la ltos/ /nang gi sems la bltas tsam na/

/mar me rlung gis ma bskyod bzhin/ /gsal la rtog pa med par gda'o/ /blo blo phyi nang mtshams su ltos/ /phyi nang mtshams su bltas tsam na/ / mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du/ /mtshan ma rang sar grol nas gda'o/ /blo blo thabs lam zab mo sgoms/ /thabs lam zab mo bsgoms tsam na/ /ded dpon bzang pos byed pa bzhin/ /sems 'dod pa'i gnas su skyol gyin gda'o/ /blo blo phyag rgya chen po sgoms/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgoms tsam na/ /nags la me lce mched pa bzhin/ /cir snang grogs su 'char gyin gda'o/ /blo blo phyogs med ldom bu gyis/ /phyogs med ldom bu byas tsam na/ /mtsho la kha ba bab pa bzhin/ / rnam rtog thad kar chod kyin gda'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rje nyid la dwags po'i slob ma bcu gsum gyis rnam rtog gis mi gnod pa'i phyag rgya chen po zhu zer ba la 'di gsungs so/ /skye 'gags med pa'i chos nyid la/ /rnam rtog bya ba ci la zer/ /ma rtogs pa dang rtogs pa gnyis/ /chu dang chu bur lta bur ltos/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ khong rnams kyis rnam rtog gzhi med rtsa bral du rtogs/ glo bo'i dge bshes zhig gis yi dam gang bsgrubs kyang zhal mthong ba'i thabs shig zhu zer ba la 'di gsungs so/ /'jig rten bya ba blos thong la/ /yid gnyis the tshom med pa yis/ /lha sku gsal la rtog med bsgom/ /'dzad med kyi long gtam ma byas par*/ /grags stong sngags kyi bzlas brjod gyis/ /de ltar byas na lha yi sku/ /myur du mthong bar the tshom med/ /ces gsungs pas khong shin tu nges shes skyes/ zla ba gsum du bsgrubs pas sgrol ma'i zhal mthong ngo*/ /yang rnam thar zhal gsungs ma las/ dbyar gcig mu ge chen po byung ba dang*/ yul mi ltogs pa rnams gros byas te/ bla ma la bka' phab zhu dgos zer nas/ nga yi 'bul skyel dang grwa pa bcom pas/ mgon g.yag gis grong la bltas/ grwa pa rnams ni ser dmag byed par 'dug nas/

nyin gcig mang bkol gyis byas pas thams cad 'dus pa dang*/ dang po'i ber dug de gyon/ chos khug de rgyab tu khur nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /lam mkhan bla ma rje la zhus pas/ /lam rgyus mkhas pa'i tshad gcig byung*/ /blo phug dam pa'i chos la gtad pas/ /gros mgo thon pa'i tshad gcig byung*/ /sgro 'dogs rang gi sems la bcad pas/ /nges shes skyes pa'i tshad gcig byung*/ /ci byed dam pa'i chos dang bstun pas/ /dge sbyor 'phel ba'i tshad gcig byung*/ /rgyal kha 'gro ba gzhan la byin pas/ /blo sna 'byongs pa'i tshad gcig byung*/ /gzhan sems ma bzung rang sems bzung bas/ /ngo srung chung ba'i tshad gcig byung*/ /gang du bsdad kyang mgron po bgyis pas/ /chags zhen chung ba'i tshad gcig byung*/ /pham kha lto rgyab gnyis la bskur bas/ /lus sems dal ba'i tshad gcig byung*/ /mgur de blangs nas ri khrod la bros pas/ grwa pa rnams kyis ser dmag bshol/ mgon g.yag kyang yar byung ba dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ zhe sdang me dpung chen po de/ /byams pa'i chu yis bsil bar byas/ /shin tu legs so rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor 'das chags sdang rtsa ba yin/ /chags zhen skyungs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsungs so/ /de nas rta'i zla ba la mtshams byas nas mi zas ma zos/ dbang bskur ma byas pas 'od gsal gyi snang ba mched nas/ grwa pa thams cad kyi byed spyod dang/ tshe stod smad kyi legs nyes thams cad shes par byung ste/ snying rje dang sha tshas gang la gang legs kyi gros gdab pas phal cher nges shes skyes nas dge sbyor mthar phyin pa byung ba la/ ngom shod bla mchod la sogs pa mi nyan pa mang po byung ste kho yul du phyin pas khyim thab tu song nas nga 'chi kha la mi 'phrad par 'dug pas yul du ma 'gro byas pas ma nyan pa la yi mug nas kho'i lag pa nas bzung nas mgur 'di blangs so/ /sangs rgyas sems can gyi mes po yin/ /dam chos sems can gyi spyi nor yin/

/mi dad ldan bgo bsha' byed tsa na/ /nor skal chad pa'i snying med po/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi rtsa ba de/ /brgyud ldan gyi bla ma yin par nges/ / 'di phyi'i dgos 'dod sgrub mkhan la/ /mos gus med pa'i snying med po/ /tshes yongs su gtugs pa'i lhag ma la/ /yengs med brtson 'grus mi brtsams par// mgu ba med pa'i phan sems kyis/ /tshe don med du skyel ba'i snying med po/ / rig pa shing kha'i byi chung la/ /'chi bdag bdud kyi bskul ma 'ongs/ /sngar bsags las kyi steng du 'gro /sdig pa byed pa'i snying med po/ /phung po zag bcas sdug bsngal snod/ /skye rga na 'chi kun gyi gnas/ /lus rdza gog bzhin du 'dor ba la/ /rtag tu re ba'i snying med po/ /zas nor sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la/ / rang gzhan don du mi spyod par/ /sngar 'dris ser sna'i gar sbyin gyis/ /'bral mi phod pa'i snying med po/ /rnam rtog gdon gyi sun ma la/ /chos nyid bskul ma mi lta bar/ /lus sems bral gyis dogs pa yis/ /sems 'phrig btsum byed pa'i snying med po/ /las rnams 'grub pa'i gsang sngags la/ /ma yengs thun bzhir mi bsgoms par/ /'dzad pa med pa'i long gtam la/ /dus 'da' ru 'jug pa'i snying med po/ /sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu la/ /sku gsum 'bral med mi bsgoms par/ /ri dwags smig rgyu snyegs pa bzhin/ /tshig phyir 'breng ba'i snying med po/ /chos nyid gtan yul mi 'dzin par/ /bdag 'dzin mel tshe byed byed po/ /rigs drug gi grong khyer sgyu mar bzung*/ /tshe thug med du 'khyams pa'i snying med po/ /zhes gsungs so/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi rdo rje'i mgur/ skye 'gags med pa'i don rtogs na/ /lta ba kun mtho rung ma mtho rung*/ /gza' gtad med pa'i ngang du zhog / gnyis 'dzin med na lta ba yin/ /sku gsum 'bral med don rtogs na/ /gnas pa kun brtan rung ma brtan rung*/ /'bad pa med pa'i ngang du zhog

/gsal la ma yengs sgom pa yin/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug ma yengs na/ /spyod pa kun rtsing rung ma rtsing rung*/ /nyam nga med pa'i ngang du zhog /chags zhen med na spyod pa yin/ /gsal la dngos med don rtogs na/ /nyams myong 'bar rung ma 'bar rung*/ /brjod du med pa'i ngang du zhog /nges shes yod na nyams myong yin/ /re dogs med pa'i don rtogs na/ /chos sku thob rung ma thob rung*/ /zhe 'dod med pa'i ngang du zhog /gdod nas grub pa 'bras bu yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ / sems 'chi med rdo rje'i mgur/ mdo rgyud man ngag nyams myong gis/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'chi med gnad/ /'di ltar rnam smin lus 'di la/ /ye shes lus ni rang dgar 'byung*/ /rnam smin lus la lha yi sku/ /gsal la der 'dzin med par bsgom/ /de nyid sems dang dbyer med de/ /sems la ngo bo ma grub pas/ /de la 'chi rgyu ga la yod/ /'chi ba zhes bya rnam rtog yin/ /rtog tshogs 'khor 'das chos ma grub/ /'pho bya 'pho byed rang sar grol/ /rnam shes gang la don pa don/ /'chi med mtha' bral 'bras bu'i mchog /dran pas mngon sangs rgya ba ni/ /ḍā ki'i srog snying srog ltar 'chang*/ /rang sems 'chi med rang grol rje btsun rat+na bīr+ya pas mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bla ma shangs pa la gser srang lnga bcu phul nas zhus te nyams su myong bar byas so// // a+thi+-i// mya ngan las 'da' khar 'brong bu btsan rgod la zhal chems su gdams pa/ bu tha snyad kyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa na/ /tha snyad kyi chos la dgos pa med/ / bslab pa dka' la brjed pa skyen/ /chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang*/ / sems nyid kyi steng du gzhol zhing 'bab/ /chos ji ltar bsam kyang gnas lugs dang*/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog /snang ba sems su shes par gyis/ /sems kyi rang bzhin skye ba med/ /skye med rtogs na 'od gsal dang*/ / blo sna de la 'gro tshad thong*/ /rgyu rkyen rten 'brel mi bslu bas/

/bu yi don gcig 'grub de mchi/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ skyes rabs kun tu 'phags mchog thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung zhing sku tshe 'dir yang brtson 'grus drag pos bsgrubs pas mtshams sbyar te 'phags pa nyid dang dbyer med pa'i mchog grub pa/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis rtsol med chu bo'i rgyun lta bu mnga' ba/ rje btsun rmog lcog pa las mkha' 'gro'i chig brgyud thob cing shar phyogs baiḍūr+ya snang ba'i zhing khams su de bzhin gshegs pa dri med nam mkha'i dpal zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i skyes mtha'i byang sems dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge la rgyal ba sras bcas kyi chos sgo mtha' yas pa bstsal pa las mtshon pa tsam ni/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhal nas/ sgyu lus bden med gnad yin a 'thas shig/ rmi lam 'dun pa'i gnad yin lam du khyer/ /'od gsal mos gus gnad yin gsol ba thob/ /gzhan don snying rje'i gnad yin phyogs 'dzin spongs/ /zhes dang*/ gnyis 'dzin spangs na 'dod chags ngang gis zhi/ /pha mar shes pas zhe sdang rang sar grol/ /gsal la rtog med gti mug dbyings su thim/ /'gags med dug gsum rang sar 'ching byed 'di/ /der 'dzin med pas rang sar grol bar nges/ /nyon mongs rang shar rang grol nyid du ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas/ 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba bdud kyi bar chad yin/ /chags sdang sna tshogs grogs su mi 'char bas/ /rkyen ngan dben pa'i dgon pa rtag tu bsten/ /tshe la long med 'chi ba bsam par rigs/ /zhes gsungs/ rgyud sde lnga'i lha tshogs kyi zhal nas/ dbang bzhi ma rdzogs smin par ga la nus/ /dbyer med bskyed rim ma bsgoms grol mi srid/ /thob 'dod re bas 'bras bu mi 'byin pas/ /rang grol rang shar sku gsum dbyer med ltos/ /zhes gsungs/ bla ma rmog lcog pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshe/ rje btsun ma'i zhal nas/

nam mkha' 'di la skye 'chi med pa ltar/ /bla ma la yang skye 'chi ga la yod/ /mos gus stobs kyis 'bral med gnas pa yin/ /mya ngan ma byed rgyun du gsol ba thob/ /ces gsungs so/ /rang sems bla mar ngo sprod pa'i rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni/ gu ru bo dhi tsit+ta na mā mi/ bla ma mnyam med sems nyid ngo sprod pa'i/ /rang don mthar phyin gzhan don nang du lon/ /phyogs med mkhyen pa'i thugs rje kun la snyoms/ /bla ma drin can rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yin lugs mtshon pa'i bla ma khyed rnams lags/ /gnas lugs shar ba'i bla ma nang na bzhugs/ /rang sems bla ma'i mtshan nyid 'di ltar lags/ /rgyu las ma byung rang bzhin lhun gyis grub/ /rkyen gyis mi 'jig gnyen po kun dang bral/ /'gro 'ong mi bdog dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /dngos dang dngos med brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /dbang po lnga la mthong ba'i dngos po med/ /med bzhin sna tshogs 'char ba'i byung khungs yin/ /bltas shing bcos kyang 'di zhes ngos bzung med/ /ma btsal bzhag kyang rang bzhin cir yang 'char/ /dge sdig las kyi dbang du de mi 'gyur/ / kun las 'phags shing gang la'ang zhen pa med/ /kun dang bral bas kun gyi dngos gzhi yin/ /blo dang bral bas don med blo la gsal/ /phyogs med de la phyogs med sna tshogs 'byung*/ /byung yang gang gi phyogs su nges pa med/ /de ltar 'di zhes kho nar ma gyur pa'i/ /ji bzhin de nyid rang gi bla ma yin/ /bla ma'i rnam thar bshad na 'di ltar bdog

/bla ma de la nye ring mi bdog pas/ /des ma khyab pa'i sems can gcig kyang med/ /bla ma de nyid smon lam dag pa'i phyir/ / kun kyang de yi rigs su ma gyur med/ /bla ma de nyid thugs rje che ba'i phyir/ /ye sangs rgyas la ma bkod cig kyang med/ /bla ma de nyid mdzad pa stobs che bas// 'khor 'das kun la 'jug cing rang dbang sgyur/ /bla ma de la 'pho 'gyur mi bdog pas/ /log par bltas kyang don de gnas pa yin/ /bla ma de dang skad cig 'bral ma myong*/ /'grogs yun ring ste sus kyang zhal mthong dka'/ /bla ma de la 'das grongs mi mnga' bas/ /gtan gyi bya ra zin pa ngo mtshar che/ /de lta bu yi rang sems bla ma la/ /rang ngo rang gis shes pa'i zhal ras blta/ /the tshom som nyi bral ba'i gsol ba gdab/ /ma bcos rang sar 'jog pa'i mos gus bya/ /rgyun du ngang la gnas pa'i zhabs tog bya/ /gsal stong ched 'dzin med pa'i zhal zas drangs/ /dran yengs dbyer med rtogs pa'i zhal skyems drangs/ / snang grags sgyu mar shes pa'i na bza' gsol/ /zag med bde ba'i 'bol stan 'og tu bting*/ /ma btsal ye nas yin pa'i dbu zhwa gsol/ /ci shar ched 'dzin med pa'i zang zing phul/ /kun mkhyen bdag 'dzin med pa'i gzim khang du/ / 'khor 'das dbye bsri med pa'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /dus gsum rgyun chad med par bzhugs nas kyang*/ /rang snang lhug pa'i gdams ngag rgyun du gsungs/ /ngo mtshar che'o rang sems bla ma nyid/ /slar yang thugs rjes bzung ba bka' drin che/ /tshe sngon sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor las 'phro che/ /de yang thugs rjes mi gtong ngo mtshar che/ /bla ma de la bsten lugs de byas pas/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs 'di ltar 'byung gin gda'/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas ma bros pa ru thar/ /sangs rgyas sa ru ma phyin pa ru slebs/ /'khor 'das gnyis la bzang ngan med par go / sangs rgyas sems can rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid ma nor rtogs gyur cing*/

/thag chod mngon du gyur na sangs rgyas zer/ /de yi yon tan brjod pa'i mtha' las 'das/ /gzhan du bla ma bsten yang 'di ltar 'byung*/ / sems nyid ji bzhin pa ru ma rtogs pas/ /de ma yin la der 'dzin shes pa zhugs/ /rjes phyir 'brangs pas sdug bsngal las la spyod/ /de la sems can zhes su btags pa yin/ /da ni rang gi bya ra rang gis byed/ /'khor ba'i rjes phyir ma 'brangs snga ma sun/ /mya ngan 'das pa mi bsgrubs rtsol ba che/ /sems nyid rang sa bzung nas rang gar sdod/ /'di zhes ngos bzung med pa'i sems nyid 'di/ /ma la ma go 'di yis sbyangs nas byung*/ /da yang mtshan nyid go ba 'di yis 'tshengs/ /'tshengs lugs ji bzhin bstan na 'di ltar lags/ /stong nyid rang chas chos sku btsal mi dgos/ /cir snang rang shar gzugs sku dgag ma dgos/ /sems nyid rang 'gros sku gsum bcos mi dgos/ /'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa chod pas dor mi dgos/ /rang sems sangs rgyas yin pas re mi dgos/ /ye nas yin pas blo yis bsgom mi dgos/ khyed kyang 'di ltar mdzad na mi legs sam/ /ma yengs sems la lta ba'i rtogs ldan rnams/ /lta ba'i blo dang bral na cis mi rung*/ /ma bral rgyun du sgom pa'i sgom chen pa/ /sgom mkhan rang thog grol na cis mi rung*/ /rtag tu byang chub sgrub pa'i sgrub pa po/ /ma bsgoms lhun grub go na cis mi rung*/ /bcos med bya ra byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rang sems gtan la phab na cis mi rung*/ /mtshan ldan bla ma mang du bsten lags kyang*/ / bla ma re la gsung sgros re re 'byung*/ /de rnams rtsa ba sems la thug nas 'dug/ de nas rang sems bla ma de nyid la/ /zhal lta gsung nyan gdams ngag mang du zhus/ /drin che'i bla ma bdun la gsol ba btab/ /bstod pa phul zhing byin rlabs zhus pa yis/ /rang sems bla ma yin pa'i rtogs pa zhig /nang nas shar bas go lugs yi ger bkod/ /'gal dang 'khrul bar mthong lags na/

/tshig la ma blta don la ltos/ /smyon pas mu cor smras pa yin/ /gang la'ang bzod par mi gsol lo/ /bzod gsol 'bul ba'i yon ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs so/ /rang sems bla ma zhes bya ba rin po che skyer sgang pas mdzad pa a+thi+-i/ sems 'chi med du ngo sprod pa'i rdo rje'i mgur/ na mo gu ru/ nyin par snang stong lha yi sku/ /na dang 'chi ba med par rtogs/ /'chi khar spyan tsam gsal bas kyang*/ /gnad gcod rang dag longs sku thob/ /brgya la gsal bar ma gyur kyang*/ /gsal dwangs rdzing bur rdo brgyab bzhin/ /sngar gyi gnad kyis bar ma dor/ /bde chen longs sku rang shar 'byung*/ /'khor ba stong par ma gyur tshe/ / gzhan don dpag med lhun grub 'byung*/ /rang sems 'chi med rang grol rje btsun dharma sing has mdzad pa'o/ /mnyam med rin chen la gser srang brgya dang*/ 'bri sum cu/ ber thul gcig rnams phul nas zhus te/ nyams su myong bar byas so// //༈ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chen pos chig brgyud gsang ba'i mdzod gtad cing mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mngon rtogs mthar phyin pa/ sa lam gyi yon tan rdzogs pas sku tshe gcig gis zung 'jug chen po'i rgyal sar rang dbang du sgyur ba sku tshe de nyid kyi phyi mar shar phyogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams me tog bkram par rgyal ba pad+ma'i dpal zhes bya bar 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba'i srid mtha'i byang sems ri gong pa chen po sangs rgyas ston pa chos kyi shes rab la bu slob rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas mtshams sbyar te tshes bcu'i tshogs 'khor gyi skabs su rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa ni/ chos dbyings mkha' la sangs rgyas sras/ /skyed mdzad bde ster ni gu dang*/ /dbang bzhis smin byas bslab gsum ldan/ /bla ma mchog bsten de nyid mkhyen/ /rje btsun rat+na bīr+ya dang*/ /snang grags sgyu mar mkhyen mdzad pa'i/ /zhen med lha skus 'gro don mdzad/ /sku gsum ngo bo chos kyi rje/

/mnyam med skyer pa sgang pa la/ /skyo ngal med pa'i dad pa yis/ /'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs/ /'dir tshogs dad ldan skyes bu kun/ / dbyangs 'di la dar cig gsan par zhu/ /brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa de/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas yin par nges/ /bla ma chos skur rtogs pa des/ /mdo rgyud don la ma rmongs shing*/ /lus gsum gnas lugs 'di ltar rtogs/ /da lta rnam par smin pa'i lus/ /bskyed pa yid kyis bskyed pa yin/ /'di la brten nas bag chags sogs/ /'khor ba bde sdug tsam du snang*/ /snga ma la ltos 'bras bu la/ /phyi ma la ltos rgyu ru gsungs/ /nyin mo'i bag chags brlan gyis ni/ /skyon yon sna tshogs rmi ba de/ /bag chags lus su btags pa yin/ /bar do yid kyi lus po de/ /thogs med dbang po kun tshang nas/ /snga ma 'dra ba'i lus su snang*// las kyi rjes su 'brang bar byed/ /rang bzhin rtogs na bde chen sku/ /ma rtogs srid pa'i rjes su 'jug /'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'dir/ /de snga chags sdang rlabs kyis bskyod/ /a 'thas zhen pa'i skyes bu de/ /sdug bsngal nyam thag don re chung*/ /'byung bzhis bsdus pa'i rnam smin lus/ /rnam smin lus la len lugs mang*/ /ma rtogs rigs drug 'khor mar len/ /nga dag pa'i sgyu lus 'di ltar len/ /rnam smin lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /bsam pa tsam gyis don rnams 'grub/ /dmigs med kyi sgyu lus 'khyams po yin/ /rang sems bla mas de skad gsungs/ /yid kyi lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /bsam pa tsam gyis don rnams 'grub/ /dmigs med kyi sgyu lus 'khyams po yin/ /rang sems bla mas de skad gsungs/ /bag chags lus la rgyal ba'i sku/ /bsam pa tsam gyis don rnams 'grub/ /dmigs med kyi sgyu lus 'khyams po yin/ /rang sems bla mas de skad gsungs/ /de ltar nyams su blangs pa las/ /'bras bu sku gsum 'di ltar 'char/ /chos sku spros bral gnyug ma'i don/

/ngo bo ngos bzung kun dang bral/ / mtshan nyid blo yi yul las 'das/ /chos sku'i ngo bo de ltar lags/ /mkha' ltar dag pa'i chos sku las/ /gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis po de/ /dpag bsam shing dang nor bu ltar/ /ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar/ /de srid gzhan don rgyun mi chad/ /sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' la/ /mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs skur snang*/ /so so skye bo la sogs dang*/ /gdul bya ma dag nyan thos la// gang 'dul sprul sku'i snang ba 'char/ /de gsum dbyer med zung 'jug la/ / bde chen sku zhes gsungs pa yin/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ni gu ma'i/ /smin grol sgyu lus gdams ngag yod/ /grangs med gsum bral blo re bde/ /dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa'i/ /yi dam lha yi lung bstan yod/ /gdams 'di'i gnad rnams ma lus yod/ /the tshom med pas blo re bde/ /gsang sgrub lte ba'i sprul 'khor dang*/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhis 'gro don byed/ /log 'tsho mi dgos blo re bde/ /'khor lo bcing grol shing rta can/ /bum pa can gyi gdams pa yod/ / skad cig ma re bsgoms pas kyang*/ /bde drod rgyun chad med par 'bar/ /bde stong ldan pas blo re bde/ /ye shes skar khung 'pho ba yod/ /sdig can gyis 'chi kha dran tsam na/ /mkha' spyod 'gro bas blo re bde/ /chos skyong ye shes mgon po dang*/ /las mgon k+ṣe tra pā la yod/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ /bran bzhin nyan pas blo re bde/ /dus khyad par can tshes bcu yar gyi ngo*/ /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs gral du/ /snying dang 'dra ba'i bu slob kyis/ /gsol ba btab nas zhus pa'i ngor/ /bde thob yangs pa'i dbyangs 'di blangs/ /'di la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs chags/ /dbyangs 'di thos par gyur pa rnams/ /bla ma chos skur rtogs pa dang*/ /lha sku phyag rgya chen po rnams/ /'bad rtsol med par rtogs par shog /dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba rnams/

/thams cad byang chub chen por bsngo/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yon sgom tshong 'dus la skyel thung mdzad pa'i dus 'gro chos zhig gnang ba zhu zhus pas 'di gsungs so/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa rin chen mdzod/ /ma rig mun sel sgron ma'i 'od/ /rnam dag don gnyis lhun grub pa'i/ /chos rje thugs kyis bkra shis shog /rnam smin lus la 'od gsal dang*/ /lha sku 'dres pa'i sems de la/ /na rgyu 'chi rgyu med par shes/ /de yi dbugs chad 'chi ba'i tshe/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal rang dag nas/ /'od gsal lha sku 'dres gyur te// bsgom bya sgom byed rang sar grol/ /skye med 'od gsal nam mkha' la/ /rang shar gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar/ /gzhan don lhun grub rgyun chad med/ /'chi brod gdams pa de ltar lags/ /ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa/ /bran bzhin nyan pa'i bka' bsgo byas/ /bu gtsang dud bzhud pa'i rdzongs pa mdzod/ /tshad med bzhi dang sems bskyed la/ /nan tan mdzad cing ci bder bzhud/ /bdag pha yang myur du mjal bar zhu/ /bkra shis pa'i mchod dbyangs de la mdzad/ /ces so/ /dge slong gzhon nu seng ges gsol ba btab pa'i ngor rnam par thar pa gsal bar gsungs pa'i mjug sdom du rdo rje'i zhal chems bstsal pa ni/ bdag gi slob ma yang slob dang*/ /'brel bar gyur pa thams cad kun/ /log pa'i bsam pa spangs byas nas/ /'bral ba med pa'i mos gus kyis/ /nga yi lus dang rgyal ba'i sku/ /tha dad ma yin rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag gi ngag dang rgyal ba'i gsung*/ /dbye ba med do rnal 'byor pa/ kho bo'i sems dang rgyal ba'i thugs/ / gnyis med gcig tu rtogs par gyis/ /'bras bu rang shar lha sku dang*/ /sku gsum dbyer med bde chen yin/ /lar tshad med mos gus ma skyes na/ /bla ma'i yon tan mthong mi 'gyur/ /mos gus mthar thug skyes gyur na/ /bla ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/

/sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa/ /rgyan gyi 'khor los sems can rnams/ /smin cing grol bar byed pa yin/ /'phrin las phun sum tshogs par rtogs/ /bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi/ /rnam par thar pa gang la yang*/ / dag pa'i snang ba ma gtogs pa/ /log rtog skad cig skye mi 'gyur/ /bla ma chos skur ma rtogs tshe/ /sgrub pa mchog la 'bad par gyis/ /de yi yon tan rdzogs par 'char/ /rnam thar mthar thug mos gus yin/ /dag snang skyed cig bu slob kun/ /ces gsungs so/ /sems 'chi med du ston pa'i rdo rje'i gsung ni/ rang grol bde chen 'dus ma byas/ /dharma sing ha'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnam smin lus la 'od gsal dang*/ / lha sku 'dres pa'i sems de la/ /na rgyu 'chi rgyu med par rtogs/ /'khor 'das spang blang rang grol lo/ /de ltar skad cig tsam shes shing*/ /dbugs chad dus su gnad gcod sogs/ /sdug bsngal thams cad rang dag nas/ /'od gsal lha sku dang 'dres te/ /skye shi med cing dgag sgrub med/ /rtogs bya rtogs byed thams cad bral/ /bsgom bya sgom byed rang grol te/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis ji srid du/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar/ /de srid gzhan don lhun grub ni/ / rgyun chad med par 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lo zla tsam gyis 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /gdams pa bla ma skyer sgang ba'i/ /drin gyis ji lta ba bzhin rtogs/ /tshe 'di blos btang rnal 'byor gyis/ /zhag bdun bsgoms pas grol bar 'gyur/ /rang sems 'chi med rang grol rje btsun dharma pradz+nyās mdzad pa rdzogs so// //dpal ldan skyer sgang pa la gser zho bcu/ ber thul gcig phul nas zhus te/ nyams su myong bar byas so/ /bla ma gsum gyis mdzad pa'i rang sems 'chi med rang grol gyi man ngag zab mo yang dag pa/ a+thi+-i/༈ rdo rje 'chang nas rim par byon pa'i brgyud pa rin chen bdun pa chig brgyud rdo rje'i rgya bkrol ba por ye shes mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa brnyes shing*/
