lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun na yongs su khyab pa'i 'phrin las can 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa brtson 'grus seng ges rang gis rang la brtson 'grus bskul ba'i lcag btab pa ni/ byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ / bla ma sangs rgyas zhabs la 'dud/ /brtson 'grus chung la the tshom che/ /lus sems gnyis la gros shig 'debs/ /tshe thung gi bya bzhag zin med la/ / yengs pa med pa mthong tsam na/ /gtan gyi so nam sgom sgrub la/ /yengs nas 'dug go sgom chen pa/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin phung la/ /mos gus kyis thugs rje ma bskul na/ /nyams rtogs kyi char rgyun mi 'bab pas/ /gsol ba thob cig rnal 'byor pa/ /yi dam dngos grub sprin phung la/ /bsnyen sgrub kyis thugs rje ma bskul na/ /mchog thun mong gi dngos grub mi 'bab pas/ /sgom bzlas la 'bungs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /chos skyong 'phrin las kyis sprin phung la/ /gtor tshogs kyi thugs rje ma bskul na/ /'phrin las kyi char rgyun mi 'bab pas/ /gtor tshogs 'bungs shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gsol 'debs bskyed rdzogs nyams len tshe/ /rnam rtog dbang du ma shor bar/ /thob 'dod re ba spangs byas nas/ /yengs med sgoms shig rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan don rtsa ba snying rje yin/ /rang bde ma bsams gzhan bde soms/ /sems can blos spang ma byed par/ /phan sems skyed cig rnal 'byor pa/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bu slob dad ldan rnams la gdams pa dgos pa bcu gnyis kyi rdo rje'i mgur ni/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dgos bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs/ /de la gong ma'i bstod pa mdzod/ /'di la dar cig gsan par

zhu/ /skye 'chis 'jigs pa'i dad pa la/ /brgyud par ldan pa'i bla ma dgos/ /the tshom med pa'i gdams ngag la/ /yengs pa med pa'i brtson 'grus dgos/ /tshe thung bsdad long med pa la/ /blo sna rtsab rtsub med pa dgos/ /dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims pa la/ /rgyun du bsring ba'i sdug bsran dgos/ /cir snang sgom du 'char ba la/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi gdams ngag dgos/ /spyod pa ma bcos rang byung la/ /chos brgyad rang sar grol ba dgos/ /'bras bu rang shar lhun grub la/ /re dogs rang sar grol ba dgos/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa la/ / mos gus rgyun chad med pa dgos/ /bla ma chos skur mthong ba la/ /log lta rang sar grol ba dgos/ /gzhan snang thul ba'i 'gro don la/ /tshad med snying rje chen po dgos/ /dgos pa bcu gnyis dbyangs chung 'di/ /sgrub pa byed pa'i mthun rkyen yin/ /ces gsungs so/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa shar phyogs sangs rgyas kyis zhing me tog bkram par gshegs pa'i tshul ston par bzhed pa'i tshe slob ma rnams la zhal gdams snying por dril nas gsungs pa/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis/ /tshad med thugs rjes bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod/ /dad gus ldan pa dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi/ /grwa pa rnams kyis nyams len 'di bzhin mdzod/ /zin med 'jig rten bya ba blo yis thong*/ /mgu ba med pa'i sems 'dzin gdung sems skyungs/ /dge sbyor dus 'da' long gtam 'dzad med shol// snga phyi'i rjes bsnyag re dogs rtog pa spongs/ /tshe la long med tha snyad thug pa med/ /ri dwags smig rgyus mi ngoms bdud rtsi 'thung*/ /rang don ma grub gzhan don mi 'byung bas/ /thog mar rang don sgrub pa rtse gcig gyis/ /skye ba 'di phyi'i gzhan don lhun grub kyis/ /'gro ba kun la tshad med snying rje bskyed/ /rang 'dod 'khri sems skad cig med pa yis/ /ci byed sems can don du sems bskyed bya/

'chi ba mi rtag rgyun chad med par soms/ /cis kyang dgos med tshe 'di blos thong 'gyur/ /don gnyis lo zlas 'grub kyis rang lus 'di/ /snang stong zhen bral lha sku 'bral med sgoms/ /nyams rtogs rtsol med 'char gyis bla ma la/ /gdung shugs ldan pas 'bral med gsol ba thob/ /'di dang 'chi kha bar do phyi ma'i tshe/ /bar chad bsrung phyir mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsten/ /rang sems phyir gyur sangs rgyas sems can med/ /ci phyir ci snang sems su shes par gyis/ /sems 'di snang stong lha sku sgyu ma ste/ /sgyu 'dzin bral ba 'od gsal phyag rgya che/ /dgag sgrub skye 'chi yod med blo las 'das/ /sgom med yid la byar med 'khor 'das bral/ /las dang las rnams smin cing rang sar grol/ / gnyis 'dzin bral ba zung 'jug chen por ltos/ /e ma ma bcos tha mal shes pa 'di/ /kun la yod kyang ma shes drin gyi rtogs/ /da ni 'dri bar mi bya thag chod nges shes skyes/ /lhun grub rnam gsum dbyer med mngon gyur to/ /zhes gsungs so/ /sems 'chi med kyi zhal gdams gnang ba ni/ rgyal ba dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /'chi med ye shes khyod la 'dud/ /sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /ldan pas gsol ba btab byas nas/ /rang lus snang stong lha sku sems/ /sems dang lha sku dbyer med pa'i/ /ngo bo stong nyid sangs rgyas kyis/ / ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs mi 'gyur/ /de la na rgyu 'chi rgyu dang*/ /'khor ba myang 'das dgag sgrub bral/ /de don skad cig rtogs pa'am/ /dran thos rig par gyur pa de/ /mtshams sbyor ngan zhing dran nyams kyang*/ /gnad gcod sdug bsngal rang dag nas/ /bar do dang po 'od gsal dang*/ /longs sku dbyer med sprul sku yi/ /gzhan don lhun grub rgyun chad med/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'chi med 'di/ /slob ma mchog gi don du bkod/ /dge des mkha' mnyam sems can rnams/

/'chi med ye shes don rtogs shog /rang sems 'chi med rang grol rje btsun bīr+ya sing has/ bu dam pa slob ma yang rab kyi don du yi ger bkod pa 'di rdzogs so// //nas khal lnga brgya/ gser zho bdun/ mdzo gcig /mon ras kyi na bza' phrugs gcig phul nas zhus te nyams su blangs par byas so/ / ༈ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston ces 'jig rten gsum na snyan par grags shing mthong thos dran reg thams cad rnam par grol ba'i dpal la sbyor bar mdzad pa de nyid kyis/ mkhas btsun 'jag chen rgyal mtshan 'bum la zhal gdams su bstsal pa ni/ nyes skyon ma gos ye shes ldan/ /mthong thos dran pas sdug bsngal sel/ /rang sems chos skur ngo sprod pa'i/ /bla ma rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa yis/ /dge ba'i tshogs rnams bsags byas te/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed bgyi/ /rtag 'dzin 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ /dge la brtson pas 'jug pa dang*/ /chags sdang blo dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'chi ba mi rtag yang yang bsgom/ / bzod med 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam/ /bde dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /dge sdig gnyis la blang dor bya/ /'bras bu mi bslu 'byung bar 'gyur/ /tha mal lus zhen bzlog pa'i thabs/ /snang la rang bzhin med pa yi/ /lha sku gsal la rtog med bsgom/ /rgyal ba longs sku rang shar 'byung*/ /dngos grub ma lus ster ba'i dpal/ /'jigs pa kun las skyob pa'i mgon/ /dpal mgon bla ma dam pa la/ /'bral ba med par mos gus bya/ /rgyun chad med par gsol ba gdab/ /cir snang rmi lam sgyu mar bsgom/ /dad 'dun gnyis kyis lam mkhyer bya/ /chags sdang rang sar grol nas mchi/ /zhen med sgyu ma rang shar 'byung*/ /sgyu 'dzin blo dang bral ba'i phyir/ /ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la bzhag/ gzung 'dzin rtog pa rang sar grol/ /gsal stong 'dzin med rang shar 'byung*/

/ shes bya gshis kyi gnas lugs la/ /skyon dang yon tan med pa'i phyir/ /de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /blang dor med pa'i don la spyod/ /snang ba rten cing 'brel 'byung 'di/ /skye med yum gyi ngang du rdzogs/ /gsal stong 'dzin med bde bar shar/ /'bras bu sku bzhi lhun gyis grub/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba des/ /'gro ba kun dang thun mong du/ /dmigs med byang chub chen por bsngo/ / theg chen chos kyi khyad chos yin/ /bla ma shangs ston rin po ches/ /slob dpon rgyal mtshan 'bum la gsungs pa rdzogs so// //༈ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas mngon sum du rjes su bzung ba'i 'gran zla dang bral ba'i grub thob chen po shangs chos nye brgyud kyi bka' babs thang stong rgyal po gtsang rgyas sde thang na gsang spyod la bzhugs pa'i skabs ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sde lngas 'phrin las ci bzhed sgrub par zhal gyis 'ches shing don dang mthun pa'i mtshan gsol ba ni/ rgyas sde thang na bzhugs pa yi/ / ya mtshan che ba'i mi 'di la/ /'dir 'tshogs bu mo rnam lnga yis/ /don dang mthun pa'i ming re 'dogs/ khyab gdal chen po'i thang chen na/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs/ /de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs/ /mnyam nyid spros bral lung pa na/ /snang stong dbyer med lta ba can/ /spang blang bral ba'i smyon pa la/ /lung stong smyon pa zhes su thogs/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i zas skom dang*/ /mi gtsang ngan skyugs gang byung la/ / phan gnod bral ba'i bcud len mkhan/ /zas rnams bcud len mkhan du thogs/ /sna tshogs rkyen rnams gang byung yang*/ /rmi lam brag cha ltar rtogs nas/ /chos brgyad zil gnon ro snyoms pa/ /rkyen rnams ro snyoms mkhan du thogs/ /'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun/ /snang yang chu nang zla ba ltar/ /rkyags gtad med par rab mkhyen pa'i/ /chos rnams rkyags gtad med par thogs/

/'gran zla bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /tshad med 'phrin las rgyas bya'i phyir/ /bde ba'i thang la 'gro ba rnams/ /da lta 'dren pa'i dus la babs/ / zhes ched du brjod do/ /rje de nyid kyis mkhas btsun bde legs pa la rang grol phyag rgya chen po'i zhal gdams rdo rje'i dbyangs su bsnyad pa ni/ bu nyon dang mkhas btsun bde legs dpal/ /sngar yang gti mug mun pas 'grib/ /chos bya snyam ngang la chos brgyad 'dres/ /phyi ma'i 'dun ma sgrub pa la/ /lag len bsam pa 'di tsho 'tshal/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma lings kyis bskyur/ /chos brgyad zhen pa cham gyis thong*/ /sems 'dzin ngo bsrung cham gyis grol/ /nye ring 'brel thag rbad kyis chod/ /bdag 'dzin srid pa'i phur pa thon/ /re dogs bsam pa lhod kyis glod// lto gos gnyis kyi 'khri ba chod/ /che 'dod ma byed dman sa zung*/ /nges 'byung sdug bsngal dang du longs/ /chags sdang 'gran sems rgyang la dor/ /g.yo sgyu bsam ngan yul nas thon/ /za 'dod tshul 'chos rang sar zhog /sdom gsum dam tshig drang por srungs/ /nga rgyal rlom sems khong khro thon/ /kun gyis brnyas kyang bzod pa sgoms/ /tha mal dgra rgod yan par thon/ /zhe sdang rang rgyud nang du thul/ /gsog 'jog ser sna'i bsam pa spongs/ /byams sems snying rje rgyud la rten/ /lha chos mi chos thams cad la/ /rang gi sems 'di dpang du tshugs/ / da len 'dun ma ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis nas re yang re thag chad/ /gnyug ma'i ngang du lhod kyis glod/ /'khrul ba'i gzhi rtsa rtsad nas chod/ /yengs med rang gi sems la ltos/ /brjed med dran pa btsir gyis zungs/ /rang ngo rang gis ma shes na/ /sdug btsir byas kyang nyon re mongs/ /gnyid dus 'od gsal ma zin na/ /sems ngo 'phrod kyang don re chung*/ /bar dor 'od gsal ma zin na/ / gnad gcod sdug bsngal sha re g.ya'/ /rang sems rang dbang ma thob na/ / bskal bar bsgoms kyang thang re chad/

/rnam rtog snga ma 'gags pa'i rjes/ /phyi ma ma skyes had de ba/ /gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ngang*/ /rten med gzhi rtsa bral ba yi/ /da lta'i shes pa so ma 'di/ /rang sems chos sku spros bral yin/ /cir snang thams cad rang gi sems/ /rang sems spros bral chos kyi sku/ /des na rnam rtog chos sku'i rtsal/ /snang ba mi 'gegs stong par grub/ /gang skyes gang shar dran pas zung*/ /lhod kyis glod la cham gyis thong*/ /rang ngo shes na yang yang mthud/ /ma bcos ma yengs rang sar zhog /'gro 'ong skye 'gag gnas gsum bral/ /'di ni phyag rgya chen po yin/ /yengs med lam du khyer ba gces/ /rtsol med lhug par skyong ba gces/ /de ltar nyams su longs pa gyis/ /nga phyogs med rgyal khams bskor ba yin/ /zhen pa bral ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /gling bzhi bskor ba'i nyi ma gnyis/ /sos dal sdod long med do ang*/ /zhes gsungs so// sems 'chi med rang grol gyi rdo rje'i mgur/ /rje btsun bla ma sangs rgyas la/ / sgo gsum gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /'chi ba ltar snang rnam rtog 'di/ /rang bzhin ma grub gnyug ma'i 'gros/ /'chi bar btags pa'i lus dang sems/ / 'chi med rang grol phyag rgya che/ /rnam smin bem po 'chi ba med/ /bag chags rmi lam ji ltar 'chi/ /sems nyid rang gdangs lha yi sku/ /gsal stong 'dzin med chu zla 'dra/ /gshis lugs stong pa spros bral la/ /na ba med cing 'chi ba med/ / myang 'das med cing 'khor ba med/ /thams cad rang sems 'khrul ba'i rtsal/ / rtsal snang gsal la 'gag pa med/ /'gags med skye med dbyings su thim/ /skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba yi/ /'chi med ye shes ngo mtshar che/ /myong ba 'dzin med ngang du bzhag /spyod lam kun dang bsres la bsgom/ /de ltar yun ring sus goms pa/ /'chi ba chos sku'i dbyings su thim/ /bar do rgyal ba longs sku 'grub/ /sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren par byed/

/skal ldan rnams kyis nyams su longs/ /rje grub thob chen po'i 'chi med rang grol rdo rje'i gsung a+thi+-i/ ༈ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ni gu mas rjes su bzung ba'i shin tu nye brgyud kyi bka' babs 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo dpal ldan kun dga' grol mchog blo gsal rgya mtsho'i sde'i zhal snga nas bstsal ba'i ni gu'i rgyab chos glu'i phreng ba las/ /chos kyi khungs dang 'brel bar brjod pa'i rdo rje'i mgur/ shrī badz+ra dha ra sā dhu pā da pra ṇa myaṃ/ rje bka' brgyud kyi dgung gnam mthon po la/ /pha grub thob kyi bla ma rgyu skar tsam/ /dbyings 'gags med kyi nyi zla 'od po che/ /de nā ro dang ni gu ma lags sam/ khong lcam sring gi sgrub brgyud chu bo'i rgyun/ /dus da lta'i skal ldan yongs kyi sgom/ /yid tshim pa ster ba'i sman chab de/ /chos nā ro dang ni gu ma lags sam/ /lugs rnam gnyis kyi bka' srol skyong ba'i rjes// dpal 'gran zla bral ba sprul pa'i sku/ /nged rtogs ldan mang po'i gtsug rgyan gcig /mgon dwags shangs kyi bka' brgyud rnam gnyis lags/ /sngon til+li dang nā ros sna drangs nas/ /mar pa dang mi las rjes bskyangs te/ /gnad zab mo nā ro chos drug la/ /rtags mngon gyur grub thob grangs las 'das/ /dus deng sang tshong dus 'o ma'i dpe/ /tshig ma nges smyon pa'i bab bcol bzhin/ / don mi 'dra rang blo'i lam 'dren pas/ /mi kho bo'i sems rtsa cung ma tshim/ /lcam mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig snying po'i bcud/ /tshig ma bcos thems yig rdo rje'i mdud/ /don snying la 'bab pa dngos po'i gshis/ /sprang yid bde'i thar lam gsos su shar/ /ming rjes 'brang ba'i blo yod na/ /sdug btsir la sgom du mi 'dzin zhing*/ khong yus la sgrub par mi 'jog pa'i/ /gu yangs kyi snying gtam glu ru len/ /dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla ma skad/ /bla ma de sangs rgyas dngos byon skad//

ci mdzad legs par blta dgos skad/ /mdzes mdzes su smras kyang sgra skad lags/ /dngos grub la thob rung ma thob rung*/ /sangs rgyas dang sems can ci yin rung*/ /mdzad pa la legs nyes ci ston rung*/ /mi nga la snyems 'phrig rdul tsam med/ /ya ki shed 'og min pho brang na/ /chos sku la rdo rje 'chang chen ces/ / mthing ga la 'od zer lham me ba/ /sems blo chung gi 'dren pa ya re cha/ /ma gi shed shangs phu'i rmogs lcog gi /pho brang de spang po'i spyil bu na/ /mi gzugs la zhu bde'i 'od 'bar ba/ /rgya sgom rdo rje 'chang chen de na bzhugs/ khyod gdod ma'i gzhi la dbyer med kyang*/ /'phral sbas pa'i brtul zhugs sgrib g.yogs mkhan/ /mi skal ldan gyis cer mthong ma lags sam/ /bum nang gi mar me ji bzhin snang*/ /bdag snga ma'i las 'phro mi dman pas/ /chung chung nas sgyu ma'i rang rtsal rdzogs/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i zhal bzang mthong na yang*/ /sems ma tshims sgyu ma'i rang snang tsam/ /pha legs rgyal zhal bum rnyed tsa na/ /blo 'khu 'phrig thams cad rang sar grol/ /yid the tshom spangs pa'i nges shes gcig/ dus de tshe 'pho 'gyur med par skyes/ /mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi 'dzin pa yal/ /thun mtshams dang thun tshod kyi snang ba brjed/ /'di yin dang 'di min gyi dgag sgrub zhig

/rang gzhan dang phyogs cha'i nye ring stor/ /kun khyab kyi gsal stong 'od po che/ /rang rig me long la shar tsam na/ /tshig tha snyad tshig gi 'byed 'grel de/ /nam dgos dus slebs pa'i spobs pa thob/ /rje mkhyen pa can gcig ma lags pa/ /mi blun po mkhas par ci la gtong*/ khyod byin rlabs can gcig ma lags pa/ /skyes grol gyi rang mtshan ci la ston/ /da dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byon lags kyang*/ /zhu dag gi spros pa mi bdog pas/ /blo dran pa rang shar nam mkha' la/ /bya lam rjes med kyi ngang la bzhud/ /sgom byas kyang pha yi rang snang tsam/ /res 'jog med pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /sal le dang sing nger 'jog lags pas/ /mthor gtong dang dmar gtong khyod rang shes/ / gsol 'debs kyi dbyangs rta snyan na yang*/ /yid gnyis kyi 'phyang mor spyod pas na/ /blo phar bltas na chung 'phyon ma'i glus/ /mi shes ldan snying khong 'dren lags sam/ /tshig mu cor smra ba'i ngu lab la/ /gzugs med kyi lha 'dre snying rtsa 'dar/ /pha dran pa'i yus chen rgyang 'bod la/ khyed dbyings nas thugs rje cis mi g.yo/ /pha bdag dang bdag gir byas pa'i bu/ /yid gcig tu 'dres pa'i spun grogs la/ /re sa dang ltos sa ma mchis pas/ /rje khyed rang gi rnam thar 'khyongs par shog /mos gus nyag gcig dran pa lam rdzogs kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su bzung ba'i rgyab chos glur blangs pa a+thi+-i/ skyabs zur 'tshol med pa'i rgya sgom la/ /blo rtse gnyis med par skyabs su mchi/ /pha nor ba med pa'i bla ma rje/ /bdag bu gcig pa'i blo sna chos la sgyur/ /las 'jig rten pa'i bsam sbyor lhur blangs nas/ /lus btsun btsun byas kyang sems kyis khrel/ /ming chos par btags pa bsnyon dor mkhan/ / 'di thugs rje gzigs dang bla ma'i gtso/ /gnas 'khor ba'i rang mtshang go bzhin yang*/ /sems g.yeng g.yeng dgos med gyi nar spyod/ /yid nem nur ri khrod phyi shol lus/

/'di blos btang lags sam mkhyen pas gzigs/ /gshis thag chod gyong po'i 'dug tshugs la/ /'phral col chung kun gyi ngo ma yogs/ / rang rang gis bslus pa'i mgo 'khor la/ /yab brtse ba'i spyan chab mi bskrun nam/ /chos go rig shes pa'i rdzun sob la/ /yid bde mor sems pa'i col chung po/ /sgom kha ltar song ba'i mdo med la/ /pha thugs kyis brnag pa mi gnang ngam/ /las 'char sgo'i blo la zad pa med/ /gshis 'khor ba'i 'dam la chod pa med/ /dus da lta'i yid shes ngos bzung med/ /'di med lta'i glu dbyangs ring mor gda'/ /he ban gzugs tho yor mig 'phrul la/ /spyang glen gyi rtog dpyod gtong ba 'khrul/ /btsun tshugs mdzes chos 'ja' snang la/ /zhen rtog gi legs nyes dpyod pa dman/ /'khor ba ngan skyug kyi khron pa la/ /dri zhim gyi 'dzin blos reg pas phung*/ /sems nges med kyi 'char sgo rgya 'byams la/ /yin min gyi so 'phrang 'dzugs pa smyo/ /dran pa nyag gcig gi yid shes la/ /chos min gyi bya ra byed pa rtsing*/ /gang byas sgyu ma'i me long la/ /bden rdzun gyi zhal lces g.yeng ba brdzun/ /ci byas thar pa'i so nam la/ /rtog dpyod kyi than pas bsregs pa pham/ /ngas shes pa tsam la ma bzhag ste/ /sgom ming stong du skad cig bzhag pa med/ /da shi yang legs la gson yang rung*/ /'dun ma dge mthar phyin pa go /zhes dran bskul gyi lcag 'debs thol skyes las brtsams pa'i rgyang glur smras pa a+thi+-i/ dbyings chos sku rtag brtan g.yung drung la/ /mdangs 'gags med kun snang yi ge'i dngos/ /dbyangs gzhom med nā da'i rang sgra gcig /yid 'gyur stong a yi ngo bor shar/ /e chos kyi 'byung gnas seng ge'i khrir/ /don stong chen yig lnga'i pho brang na/ /waṃ bde chen 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /nang thig le yig drug 'dus pa'i lha/ /ming bde gshegs snying por grags pa gcig / yongs sems can kun la khyab pa'i bdag

/rang rnal 'byor yid bde dam pa'i dpal/ /dus 'gyur ba med pa'i dkyil 'khor las/ /chab dag pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /blo kun rtog gi ri mo bag la nyal/ /las nyon mongs kun 'byung bkrus nas kyang*/ /sems rang rig rang gsal 'od po che/ /yid phar bltas chos sku nyag gcig la/ /blo tshur gzhal dran pa'i rgyun lam chad/ /yid had de chad de wal le ba/ /deng yid kyi ri mo yal nas thal/ /lus sha khrag dri med gzha' 'dra'i sku/ /ngag smra bsam brjod 'das lkugs pa'i tshul/ /yid bya lam rjes bral nam mkha'i ngang*/ /don 'char sgo dang po'i ye shes yin/ /gzhi ma rig mun pa'i khang chung brdibs/ /las nyon mongs dri ma'i bag chags gtor/ /ming so so skye bo'i yul las 'das/ /sgom blo 'das chen po'i lam dang mjal/ /chos brgyad khri bzhi stong ar bsdus nas/ /lha shākya mu nes gsungs lags kyang*/ /gnad dril don 'di ltar ma shes na/ /tshig yi ge bzlas kyang brjod pa yin/ /ces dag byed stong ra'i skabs las bsgrags pa'i glu a+thi+-i/ sgrib med kyi rang gzugs lha ru shar/ /lha rnal 'byor ma dpal mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /nyams bde stong myos pa'i lang tsho ma/ /sems bdag po'i pang par cud kyis byung*/ /phyi snang ba lha yi gzhal yas la/ /nang dar dmar gur khyim srab la dwangs/ /logs me dpung 'bar ba'i thig le bzhi/ /gnad lte ba'i 'khor lo mgal me bzhin/ /raṃ sum mdor 'phros pa'i me lce yis/ /glog dbu ma'i rgyu lam yangs po nas/ /steng dkar gsal spyi bo'i rgya mthongs las/ /dpe skar mda' mkha' la bgrod pa bzhin/ /rje bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chab/ /sgo tshangs pa'i lam nas rab zhugs te/ /lam dbang bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrig bzhin tu/ /bla ma dang rang sems dbyer ma shes/ /gtum mo las brtsams pa'i glu a+thi+-i/ blo cir snang dang ci shar sgyu ma'i nyams/ /'ol thol skyes kyi dran pa byang chub lam/

/gnad gzer bu 'debs pa bla ma'i gsung*/ /'di brjed pa med pa'i gzungs su 'dzin/ /'dzin bcas kyi dran shes gsar bu'i sgom/ /sgom yid dpyod kyi lam mkhan gnas skabs kyi chos/ /chos yin lugs kyi byar me dgu yang gcig /gcig shes kun grol ngo mtshar rmad/ /sgyu lus skabs a+thi+-i/ rmi lam gyi 'char sgo nyams kyi sne/ /'dun pa yi yid shes mtshams sbyor gyi ngag /thig le'i bzhi 'gros rten 'brel gyi gnad/ /ma ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gsang ba'i gtam/ /sems 'khyams po la gtad so ma dmigs phyir/ /steng dga' ldan du 'gro ba thag mi ring*/ /yid kun snang la mi 'char med pa'i dpe/ / 'phral gang dgos su bde bsgyur rnal 'byor pa'i nyams/ /nyams byung rgyal la dgag sgrub mi bgyid par/ /dus rgyun mi chad dran pa'i kha lo bsgyur/ /rmi lam gyi skabs a+thi+-i/ gzhi 'od gsal 'gyur med rtag pa'i sku/ /lam 'od gsal 'gags med bde ba'i cha/ /mthar 'bras bu mngon gyur rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gnad gzhi lam 'bras bu'i mtshams sbyor lags/ /lam 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas la/ /yid ar la gtad pa'i dran pa'i mda'/ /sgo tshangs pa'i lam nas rgyangs bton te/ /blo ma yengs chos skur lhan gyis 'jog /dus da lta'i las snang ji snyed pa/ /gshis ma grub chu nang zla ba bzhin/ /don 'di yang nges shes skyes pa na/ /phyis bar do rgyal ba longs sku 'grub/ /bar do'i skabs a+thi+-i/ ༈ gnas gsar ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i gsung mgur dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos kyi lam rim snying por dril ba'i gsol 'debs snying gi bdud rtsi zhes bya ba na mo gu ru be/ rje rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*/ /chos sgrub brgyud yongs kyi gtsug rgyan mchog /pha 'brel tshad don ldan dkar rtsi ba/ /bu pha dang mnyam par byin gyis rlobs/ /tha mal gyi shes pa so ma 'di/

/skyon bzhi yi dbang du ma song bar/ /rang ngo bo rjen par mthong ba yis/ /gzhi phyag chen rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'og lte ba'i a thung 'od 'bar la/ /srog rtsol gyi rlung gis bsrubs pa las/ /gzung 'dzin gyi bud shing sreg byed pa'i/ /lam gtum mo 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid dang 'khor 'das gnyis snang kun/ /med bzhin du du mar 'char ba yi/ /rang stong gi rang mtshang rtogs byed pa'i/ /lam sgyu lus 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /nying 'khrul gyi bag chags tshan po che/ /shar tsam nas rang ngo shes pa dang*/ /bden med kyi rtsal snang 'bar ba yi/ /lam rmi lam 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ma rig bag chags a 'thas kun/ /stong nyid kyi dbyings su thim pa las/ /'gags med kyi stong gzugs 'od po che/ /lam 'od gsal 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'khrul snang gi lus gsum rgyal ba'i skur/ /gdod ma nas bzhugs par ngo shes pas/ /gnyis snang gi 'jigs skrag rang sar grol/ /lam bar do 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /tshe 'di yi zhen pas ma bcings bzhin/ /'chi ba la 'jigs pas mi sun par/ /chos dbyings kyi nam mkhar thogs med bgrod/ /lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ / snang srid kun bla ma'i rol pa las/ /spang blang gi spro bsdu mi dgos par/ /rtsol med kyi gdung shugs drag po yis/ /lam bla mas bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'khor 'das kun rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /tha mal gyi 'dzin pas ma bcings par/ /yul gang shar lha sku'i ye shes su/ /lam yi dam gyis bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /cir snang kun bden med sgyu ma la/ /a 'thas kyi rtog pas ma bcings shing*/ /rgyu 'dzin gyi zhen pas ma gos par/ /lam sgyu mas bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang sems 'di stong nyid rnal 'byor ma/ /rang rtsal du phag mo sgyu ma'i gar/ /rdzas gsang sngags tshogs kyis mnyes byas nas//

gshis mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mchog yan lag lnga bsdu'i sbyor ba yis/ /ma dag pa'i mngal sgo sbyangs byas te/ /stong nyid kyi bha gar brtse bas rol/ /lam zung 'jug rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rnam shes kyi bzhon pa las kyi rlung*/ /'khrul 'khor gyi sbyor bas bcings pa las/ /don rtsa rlung thig le dbang 'dus nas/ /lus 'chi med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ma bcos pa'i shes pa sgyu ma'i sku/ /yab yum gyi rol gar bde chen gyi ngang*/ /ma yengs pa'i rang ngo bskyangs pa las/ /sems 'phyugs med 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /dpal ye shes mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /rten phyi nang gsang bas mchod cing brten/ /lam bskyed rdzogs bzlas pas dbang 'dus nas/ /las gang brtsam 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /don mkha' 'gro'i snying gtam rdo rje'i tshig /chos zab mo'i gser chos rnam pa lnga/ /lan brgya phrag bshad sgrub dpal 'byor gyis/ /bu snod ldan smin par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus 'di nas sangs rgyas ma thob par/ /rje khyed dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ /thugs ci mnyes bya ba sgrub bzhin du/ /lam 'di nyid bsgom par byin gyis rlobs/ /mi bdag cag ltos par bcas pa la/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rjes byin brlabs nas/ /gshis rang bzhin 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /dpal bde mchog 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes bla ma shangs pa'i gser chos kyi smon lam shugs 'byung glur blangs pa a+thi+-i/ ༈ 'phags yul gyi grub pa'i dbang phyug rnams dang spang rtogs dbye ba med cing rtsod pa'i dus kyi rdo rje 'chang chen po/ /dpal de bī ko ṭir ye shes mkha' 'gros gsang ba'i mdzod gtad pas zab lam shin tu nye brgyud kyi bka' babs shing rta chen po kun dga' snying po'am mtshan yongs su grags pa rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa tā ra nā thas rdo rje'i do ha ji snyed cig bstsal pa las/

dgung lo nyer gsum pa bsam sdings su bzhugs pa'i tshe rang la skul ba'i gros 'debs su gsungs pa ni/ oṃ swa sti/ skyabs gnas rin chen gsum la gus btud nas/ /rang gi sems la shar ba'i tshig 'di smra/ /dben pa'i ri bor mnyam bzhag byed do skad/ /gzhan gyi mig ngor pho tshugs bzang na yang*/ / brtags na sems dang chos su ma 'dres pa/ /'di 'dra dam chos gsha' ma ga la yin/ /da ni snying nas sgrub pa byed re ran/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma skyungs dang snying med po/ /thos bsam lta rtog chos bshad rem na yang*/ /rkyen ngan bag re'i steng du dam chos 'dor/ /mkhas par grags kyang mi tshe stong zad mkhan/ /'di 'dra bshes gnyen dam pa ga la yin/ /da ni rang gi sems rgyud 'dul re ran/ / mdzub mo nang du khug dang snying med po/ /'khor ba'i gnas tshul 'phral 'phral mthong na yang*/ /yid ches cung zad med pa'i tshod med po/ /pha rol 'gro tshe gding drod mi gda' na'ang*/ /bsam mno mi gtong smyon pa rgya yan mkhan/ /da ni phyi ma'i grabs shoms byed re ran/ /blo kha chos la sgyur dang snying med po/ / 'khos ka 'di las med kyang chags sdang can/ /yon tan 'di la nga rgyal ri rab tsam/ /mgu mkhan su yang med kyang mthun 'jug mkhan/ /byas pa chung la re ba che ba khyod/ /da ni 'jig rten chos brgyad spong re ran/ /gang shar ro snyoms gyis dang snying med po/ /chos phyir gnyid thum re yang gcog mi nus/ /da lo da gzod byed snyam ngang ring po/ /myong rtags 'phral la dgos pa'i stong yus can/ /zas nor snyan grags 'dod pa'i blo ma khugs/ /da ni 'dun ma chig 'gril byed re ran/ /gting nas re dogs skyungs dang snying med po/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas lang tsho yol zhing nyams/ /'khor 'dabs kun gyis phan lan gnod pas 'jal/ / da dus sun pa med pa'i blo rgya can/ /mi shes bzhin du tshe 'di'i 'dun grabs byed/ /da ni snying nas bya btang byed re ran/

/phyogs med rang blo sbyongs dang snying med po/ /bla ma'i ming can rnams kyang chos mi byed/ /slob ma rnams kyang dam tshig srung mkhan med/ /skye bo kun kyang ngo tsha khrel gzhung med/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ /gzhan la phan thabs ji tsam byas na yang*/ /phal cher mi phan rang la gnod par 'dug /rang nyid chos la brtan pa thob phan chad/ /gzhan don rgyun mi chad pa 'byung bas na/ /re zhig tshe 'di khong la gcags pa yi/ /gzhan don ltar snang bor la rang don mchog /dam pa'i chos la sgril ba'i dus su gda'/ /de ltar lags pas da dung bsam mno thong*// zhes gsungs so/ /bu slob kyi mchog gyur gangs dkar ba dad can nyi ma rnam rgyal la ngo sprod kyi snying po gnang ba/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen grub thob tshul/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis don chen ldan/ /bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la sgyur/ khyed thugs rje'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus da re mi lus thob pa dang*/ / mtshan ldan gyi rje dang mjal skabs 'dir/ /nyams len la 'bad 'bungs ma bton na/ /mi tshe don med du 'gro nyen gda'/ /nyams len gyi rgyal po mos gus yin/ /mthun rkyen gyi rgyal po nges 'byung yin/ /bya byed kyi rgyal po byar med yin/ /mnyam bzhag gi rgyal po rang shar yin/ /rgyal po bzhi ldan gyi gdams ngag 'di/ /mtshan ldan bla ma'i gsung ngag yin/ /grub thob yongs kyi thugs bcud yin/ /tā ra nā tha'i nyams myong yin/ /mtshan bcas kyi nyams len phyogs re ba/ /sdug dus mi phan pa'i skyid chos de/ /thabs mkhas kyi bkri tshul yin mod kyang*/ /sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod mi thub/ /rang zhal rjen par lta ba la/ /mtshan ldan rje la mos gus dgos/ /bla ma sangs rgyas skad pa'i kha snyan dang*/ /ci mdzad legs par lta dgos kyi sdug zhen can/ /ma byas bsam byung tsam gyi mos gus de/ khog zhe nas ltem rkyang log ge ba/ /chos rang gis byed snyam tshugs bzang yang*/

/de sgra skad tsam las don mi mthong*/ /sangs rgyas dang sems can gyi 'then phyogs med/ /thugs chos sku skye med nyag gcig la/ /mdzad spyod nyes na'ang nyes go chod/ /phyogs med kyi 'gro don rgya re che/ /

byin rlabs zhugs rung ma zhugs rung*/ /dngos grub thob rung ma thob rung*/ / skyabs gnas gzhan na med do zhes/ /blo thag chod la gsol ba thob/ /thugs yid dbyer med du mnyam par zhog /sgom mi skye ba'i rang dbang ga la yod/ / zas gos 'dzom pa'i skyid 'dod de/ /dge sbyor 'chag la g.yeng ba che/ /mthun rkyen du ming btags rnam g.yeng de/ /rnal 'byor pa la dgos pa med/ /yid nges 'byung skyo shas drag po de/ /rang gcig pur sdod na skyo rogs yin/ /lus na tsha byung na nad g.yog yin/ /zas gos dran pa'i rnam g.yeng la/ /gdong zlog byed pa'i mthun rkyen yin/ /sngar ma byas pa cig med pa la/ /byas tshad 'khor ba'i g.yos su song*/ /da byar med kyi ngang du lhod de zhog /gtan gyi btsan sa zin te mchis/ /blos byas kyi dge sbyor brtson na yang*/ /'gyur med kyi gtan sa zin pa med/ /dbyings 'pho 'gyur med pa'i gnad ka des/ /rang babs su bzhag na 'gyur med thob/ /rang shar la bzo bcos mi 'tshal te/ /bcos min la ngo shes gal re che/ /sems rnam rtog med par rang gsal na/ /gsal ba gsal zhing stong pa de/ /rang ngo shes na chos skur 'dug /rang gis rang ngo shes dus na/ /rtog pa'i cho 'phrul ci che yang*/ /bde sdug gi 'char sgo gang mang yang*// thams cad chos sku'i yo langs yin/ /rtog pa dang mi rtog khyad par med/ / gnas pa dang 'gyu ba'i rang mtshang zhig /chab rom chu ru zhu ba ltar/ /gang snang rang sems su lhang nge ba/ /snang dus nas rjes med yul yul po/ /stong tsam gyi 'char sgo ma 'gags pa/ /ya ki sangs rgyas kyi sku gsum nas/ /ma ki dmyal khams yan chad kun/ /thams cad mi 'char bya ba med/ /ci ltar shar yang spros dang bral/ /ngag brjod pa kun gyi yul las 'das/ /sems rang rig bde ba chen por myong*/ /slar spros bcas kyi dge ba gong 'phel bya/ /thams cad phyag chen gyi yo langs yin/ /thabs shes rab tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa las/

/sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa rtogs pa yin/ /de nyams su blangs na bdud rtsi 'dra/ kha ltar shor na stong shob yin/ /rgyud thog tu nyams su longs pa zhig 'tshal/ / nyams len la rang byan tshud pa cig zhu/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang nges 'byung skul ba'i lcag 'debs zhal gdams su bstsal ba/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ pha rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas/ /'dir snying gtam tshig gsum smra ba ni/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba ni 'ja' tshon dang 'dra/ /'di yi rjes 'ded mi 'tshal lo/ /snang ba 'di rang sems kyi byed pa gcig lags/ /tha dad du 'dzin zhen mi 'tshal lo/ /rig pa zhen med du ma shar na/ /sgom byas tshad bzang rdzur 'gro nyen gda'/ /rang sems tshir gyis ma bzung na/ /don med kyi las la zad nyen gda'/ /rang don la hril gyis ma sgril na/ /gzhan don ltar snang gi mgo bskor yong*/ /da res tsam ma gtogs mi lus ni/ /yang yang du thob pa shin tu dka'/ /ngan song gsum du skyes tsa na/ /dam chos kyi skal pa ni gcig kyang med/ /da res rdog sna gcig 'dred na ni/ /dmyal ba'i gting rdo gcig byed byed 'dra/ /phyi ma la phan pa'i dge ba dang*/ /nyams len byas rjes ni 'di khar gda'/ /sdig pa dang nyes ltung ni char ltar 'bab/ /don 'di ltar bsams la chos la 'bungs/ /rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yang myur du 'ong*/ /na tsha dang mi 'dod pa byung tsa na/ /sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i shes pa de/ /chos kyi lam du longs dka' bas/ /skyid dus nas chos la 'bungs ba zhu/ /re zhig rang cag tsho'i mi tshe la/ /rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi dar rgud dang*/ /yar bla ma slob dpon gyi gnas lugs dang*/ /grwa rogs dang grogs mched kyi 'byung lugs dang*/ /pha ma dang dgra gnyen gyi gnas lugs sogs/ /thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang mtshang ston/ /'phral lo dang zla ba zhag re la/ /mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon kun/ / skyo ba skyed byed kun gam na 'dug /nam yang tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/

/ji ltar byas kyang 'dor ba la/ /bu bya ba btang la sgrub pa 'tshal/ /lus mi rtag sha rus 'gyes 'gyes 'dra/ /gces gces mor byas pa'i lus 'di yang*/ /mtha' ma rus pa'i phung por gda'o/ /rang ser snas 'bad 'bungs bsags pa yi/ /nor kun yang sus thob dang bgo bshar byed/ /da lta zas gos kyis 'byor pa yang*/ / ro shun dang ro zas kham gcig yin/ khong kha drag dpung pa 'dzom pa yang*/ / dus nges med 'chi ba byung ba'i tshe/ /nor mnga' thang longs spyod kun bor nas/ / slar ngan song gsum du 'grim pa mthong*/ /lar mi rtag 'dus byas spyi lugs yin/ /don 'di la bsams nas chos la 'bungs/ /byams snying rje phyogs med du sbyong ba dang*/ /'phral gang shar la zhen med du skyong ba dang*/ /tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum/ /dus gnas skabs kun tu rin po che/ /pha bla mar yid ches blos khel gyi/ /snying thag pas gsol ba 'debs par 'tshal/ /lar nam yang bslu ba med par nges/ /nges 'byung dang snying rje mos gus dang*/ /zhen med yengs med du skyong ba ste/ /don bzhi po 'di la 'bad gyur na/ /'dun ma rtse la phyin pa yin/ /ces so/ /dar yul brag nag tu rgyal bzang rtogs ldan rin chen bkra shis kyis zhal gyi gdams pa zhus pa la 'di gsungs so/ /bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bu snang ba sems la khyad par med/ / gang shar bzo bcos med par zhog /snying rje dang stong nyid 'gro ldog gcig/ snying rje 'dzin par ma shor zhing*/ /stong nyid chad stong du ma lus pa'i/ /zung 'jug nyams len gal re che/ /las 'bras kyi blang dor phyin ci log /cis kyang dgos med kyi nges 'byung stor/ /gzhan phan mkha' khyab kyi sems bral ba'i/ / stod skad rbad khams kyi phyag chen dang*/ /mu stegs pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rlung la/ / blo rtse gtod pa'i sgom chen de/ /blo chung gi mgo bskor mkhas srid kyang*/ /sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i lam las gol/

/bu sangs rgyas gsung bzhin sgrub gyur na/ / sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu yin pas/ /bzang 'dod kyi tsab tsub ma mang bar/ / lus ngag yid gsum chos dang bstun/ /lta ba mtho la yangs pa dang*/ /spyod pa zhib tig skabs su bab/ /sgom pa yengs med rgyun chad med/ /de gsum 'dzoms na 'bras bu smin/ /bza' btung don gnyer gyi kha spyang can/ /rgyal khams bskor ba'i zog po la/ /sgom chen gyi dri yang mi 'ongs pas/ /dben pa'i ri la tshugs par 'tshal/ /long gtam la chags shing zhen pa des/ /ngag gi bden tshig ga la 'grub/ /nus na gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod kyis/ /min na'ang smra ba bcad na legs/ /mthun 'jug dang mi dge'i ngos srung gis/ / sems bzhag kyang chags sdang 'phel ba'i ngang*/ /'di spangs kyang spangs pa dka' ba'i phyir/ /rbad kyis chod la rgyangs kyis bskyur/ /nyams myong cung zad skyes skabs su/ /bzang 'dzin skyes na bdud kyis khyer/ /dpe ri la 'dzegs pas g.yang la lhung*/ /mtho ru song gin sgrim pa gces/ /bla ma'i zhal lung gi gdams ngag rnams/ /chud zos med par nyams su longs/ /ham pa dang 'ud gog ma che bar/ /rtse gcig tu bsgoms na 'tsheng ba yin/ /ces so/ /la stod spa lung gi rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig gis gdams ngag zhus pa la 'di gsungs so/ /na mo gu ru/ pha gcig chog rgyal po bla ma la/ /dus rgyun chad med par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag bu slob kyi blo sna chos la bsgyur/ /sems mkha' khyab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dus da res mthun rkyen kun 'dzom zhing*/ / mtshan ldan rje dang mjal ba dang*/ /gdams ngag zab dgu thob dus 'dir/ / don med du ma lus pa cis kyang 'tshal/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po la/ / rtag 'dzin gyi yid brtan mi rung bas/ /dge sbyor phyi shol ma byed par/ /'phral 'phral du lag len la thebs par mdzod/ /nyams su ma myong ba'i stong shob can/ /stong nyid kyi rbad gog khar khyer nas/

/nag po kha 'byams su song nyen bdog /las 'bras la zhib tig gal re che/ /mos gus gdung ba rgyun chad med/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs la nan tan mdzod/ /de la'ang bden zhen mi 'tshal te/ /bla ma'ang rang sems las logs na med/ /rang ngo ma shes pas 'khor bar 'khyams/ /tshugs med kyi snying rje gal re che/ /bden med kyi 'khrul pas bslus pa yi/ /bde sdug kun rmi lam lta bur ltos/ /rang sems tha mal gyi shes pa 'di/ /bcas bcos mi dgos chos sku yin/ /rnam rtog gi 'char sgo ci shar yang*/ /chu dang rlabs bzhin go bar gyis/ /spyod pa zhib rtsing ci ltar yang*// ngo lkog gi rdzun rib mi 'tshal te/ /de yang chos dang mthun pa gces/ /chos 'gal gyi sgom chen phaṭa tshar re/ /sgom pa khor yug rgyun chags de/ /byar med las med gal re che/ /de yang rtsol med kyi dran pas bzung*/ /mu thom du lus na the le le/ /'bras bu rang sems sangs rgyas 'di/ /gzhi thog tu zob stong ma lus shing*/ /re dogs kyi g.yang sar ma lhung ba/ /thag chod kyi shes pa'i nges shes dgos/ /gang snang thams cad chos sku la/ /phyogs 'dzin gyi dbye ba med lags mod/ /gcam bu'i dag snang 'dis rang tshugs skyel/ /bla ma'i brgyud pa zin par mdzod/ /ces so/ /re zhig gtsang g.yo ru na bzhugs pa'i skabs snang ba thams cad ngo sprod kyi slob dpon tu shar bas rdo rje'i glu 'di ltar gsungs so/ /oṃ swa sti/ bdag phyogs ris bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dus me tog ldan pa khyu mchog lo/ /yul bkra shis 'phel ba'i g.yo ru na/ /rje bla ma'i bka' drin snying la dran/ /sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /mthar da lta'i bar du 'khyams pa lags/ /lar 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa 'dir/ /sems can sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i rin po che/ /'gro drug pha ma drin che yang*/ /'khor bar bskyur rogs gcig ma lags pa/ /gtan gyi 'dun gros la sbyor mkhan med/

/ snying gi 'dun gros de rje la zhus/ /lus sha khrag 'dus pa'i phung po 'di/ /nam 'jig la nges pa cung zad med/ /shi rjes su brod pa'i gdeng med kun/ /rig pa 'di nang du 'gugs par zhu/ /nga 'chi bas 'jigs nas bla ma btsal/ /nyams len kun rdo rus thug par 'bad/ /da tsam nas shi yang blo re bde/ /blo bde tshags su tshud pa gcig mi dgos sam/ /nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba 'di dang gcig /mtho dman 'byor rgud kyi ri mo 'di dang gnyis/ /rgyal khams yul phyogs kyi 'gyur tshabs 'di dang gsum/ /'dus byas mi rtag pa ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /byas kyang zin med kyi zhing las 'di dang gcig / bskyangs kyang drin med log sgrub kyi spyod pa dang gnyis/ /'thung yang ngoms med kyi lan tshwa'i chu dang gsum/ /las don med du ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /grong khyer 'du 'dzi'i lang long 'di dang gcig /brel la don chung sbrang bu'i spyod pa 'di dang gnyis/ /sprin dkar ban bun gyi 'gyed 'khor 'di dang gsum/ /'khor ba gtad med du ston pa'i ngo sprod gcig gda'/ /snang la gzugs med kyi 'ja' tshon 'di dang gcig /lhang lhang dmigs med kyi brag cha 'di dang gnyis/ /med kyang dga' sdug 'char ba'i rmi lam dang gsum/ /snang ba rang sems su ston pa'i slob dpon gcig gda'/ /phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dang gcig /nang rig pa sems kyi 'char sgo dang gnyis/ /dbyings ngos gzung bral ba'i stong nyid dang gsum/ /chu la chu bzhag bzhin du dbyer med gcig gda'/ /lar nyams myong cung zad gcig skyes tsa na/ /snang ba gang shar ci shar ngo sprod du 'dug /sgo gsum bya ba ci byas bogs 'don du gda'/ /don 'di la bsams na a la la/ /da yang mi tshe'i lhag ma cung zad 'di/ /nyams len sgrub pa la skyel ba dang*/ /dben pa'i ri khrod zin pa dang*/ /gang shar lam du longs pa ru/ /drin chen bla ma rin chen gyis/

/sngar tshad bzung med par byin rlabs mod/ /da yang byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /skyabs gzhan na med do chos kyi rje/ /tā ra nā thas rgyal khams kyi 'gyur lugs 'dra mthong bas/ /sems la ngo sprod pa ltar gyur pa'i skabs shig tu glur blangs pa'o/ /yar 'brog stag lung du tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i tshe rdo rje nā da'i rang sgra bsgrags pa ni/ na mo ma hā mu drā ya/ dbyings dbye ba chen po'i nam mkha' la/ /rig pa ye shes phyogs med kyi rtsal/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gza' skar bkra /rje dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang*/ /sprang gus pas khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /lar byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /ya gi shed dag pa'i zhing khams na/ /sku mi 'gyur bde ba chen po'i thugs/ khong rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa de/ /yongs dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yin no skad/ /de gzhan na yod pa ma yin te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma gcig pu lags/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /mi nga yang brtan pa cung zad zin/ /gzhi ma bcos gnyug ma'i gnas lugs la/ /thag chod kyi gdeng 'di nyams su dga'/ /sems gsal la dwangs pa'i rang snang la/ /mi 'char bya ba ni gcig kyang med/ /de shar tsam nyid nas grol ba 'di/ /rang grol gyi rnal 'byor ma lags sam/ /yongs rang ngo shes pa'i yengs med 'di/ /zhi gnas kyi sgom zhes bya ba lags/ /rang bzhin ma rnyed pa'i rtsa bral 'di/ /lhag mthong shes rab ma lags sam/ /rje rang sems dang dbyer med du shes tsa na/ /chos sku zhal mjal la dka' rgyu med/ /rang zhal mthong ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /'du 'bral med pa'i mos gus skyes/ /bdag dal 'byor mi lus thob pa dang*/ /spyir du chos dang mjal ba dang*/ /sgos su gsang sngags thob pa dang*/ /yang sgos zab don rig pa 'di/ /sngon cung zad bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /blo cung zad chos la song ba dang*/ /rje mtshan ldan bla mas bskyangs pa dang*/

/chos mdo rgyud la nges pa rnyed pa dang*/ /'phral chags sdang phyogs ris med pa 'di/ /yul gang du bsdad kyang skyid par gda'/ /tshe 'dir ltas kyi bde ba'i mgo bskor dang*/ /gtam snyan gyi phye 'thor ma blangs shing*/ /dbang thang la smon sems ma byas pas/ /dus nam yang blo sems bde mor byung*/ /phyi chos su brdzus pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ /ngan khong du bzung ba'i ngag snyan dang*/ /phug rang 'dod kha rgyal gyi gzhan don byed/ /don 'di gsum spangs pas chos su song*/ /tshul 'di yang dpal ldan bla ma'i drin/ /da dung yang gsol ba 'debs lags pas/ /byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can/ /rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs kyis/ /deng phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /ces so/ /dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos kyi lam rim dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams bdud rtsi'i snying po zhes bya ba ni/ na mo gu ru be/ dbyings skye ba med pa'i nam mkha' la/ /gdangs 'gags pa med pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /thugs rje'i 'od brgya 'gyed pa yi/ /pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang la 'dud/ /rje de nyid kyi thugs rje'i char sprin las/ /chos gdams ngag gi char rgyun phab pa de/ /mi kho bo'i sems kyi zhing sar babs/ /'bras bu nyams rtogs kyi lo tog rgyas/ khyed skal ldan yod na 'di las longs/ /dpal rdo rje 'chang chen skad pa des/ /rgyud mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snying po lnga/ /zab dgu bsdus pa'i nye lam zhig

/ming ni gu chos drug zhes bya ba/ /ma mkha' 'gro kun gyi gsang tshig de/ /nges gsang bdud rtsi'i snying po de/ /pha bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi de/ /dus de ring rgyal khams kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /phyogs med kyi ldum bur spyod pa zhig /nges med kyi tshul la spyod bzhin du/ /gnas ri gong dpal gyi gzhal yas 'dir/ /don snying po rdo rje'i glu ru len/ /gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo las/ /brda skye med mtshon pa a yi brda/ /'phrul bdud rtsi 'bab pa dmigs pa'i gnad/ /nyams sdig sgrib dag pa'i nges shes can/ /ming yang dag byed stong ra zer/ /'di sngon 'gro la gnad du che ba zhig gda'/ /rten rdo rje'i lus la rtsa thig gi 'gros/ / gzhi gnad du che ba 'khor lo bzhi/ /'phral 'bar 'dzag rang lus dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /'di rgyud sde'i nges gsang gnad du che/ /rkyen thabs dang shes rab 'dzom pa las/ /gzhi rang sems gnyug mar ngo sprod pa/ /rten thig le dbab ldog dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /de yin ni las kyi gtum mo yin/ /zer ni gzhan lus kyi gdams pa zer/ /'dod yon lam 'khyer la gnad du che/ /mi kho bos bde stong dbyer med du bsgom/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang bde stong dbyer med sgrubs/ /tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub 'dod na/ /lam gzhan la med do skal ldan kun/ /bde drod rang 'bar gcig mdzad de 'tshal/ /phyi snang ba sgyu ma'i lam khyer de/ /lus byas kyang sems kyi rang snang tsam/ /rang snang lha sku rang shar la/ /sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa zhig /sgyu lus kyi gdams pa'i snying po'i don/ /mi ngas kyang 'di la nyams len byas/ /chags sdang gi snang ba rang sar dag /a 'thas sbrul gyi mdud pa zhig /khyed 'dir 'dus kyang a 'thas bshig pa gcig 'tshal/ /'phral 'dun pa sgyur ba'i gnad ka las/ /rig pa'i rang rtsal phyogs med kyi gdangs/ /dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba 'grol ba la/ / nges med du sbyong ba gnad du che/

/ming yang rmi lam gyi gdams ngag zer/ /sgyu lus pa rnams la mkho ba lags/ /gzhi gdod ma'i rang zhal lta ba dang*/ /rkyen mos gus gdung ba'i shugs drag dang*/ /gnad rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel las/ /sems rdo rje'i rang bzhin 'od gsal che/ /dus nyin par rtsol ba bskyed bskyed nas/ /mtshan mo rang shar gyi gsal snang can/ /gsal tsam nyid nas stong par shar/ /gsal stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal zer/ /zhu bde dang gnyug ma 'dres pa las/ /nyams bde tsam nyid nas rang dag gcig /bde stong dbyer med kyi 'od gsal yin/ /sems rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa la/ / sgrib gnyis rdzun gyi stong zob yal/ /dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal yin/ / 'od gsal lam gyi 'bras bu de/ /rdo rje 'chang chen gyi spyan snga ru/ /gdams ngag rnams phu thag chad par zhus/ /zhus pa tsam la yang ma bzhag par/ /rang sems dang 'dres pa'i nyams len byas/ /ban bun nyams kyi 'char sgo dag /'gyur med rtogs pa'i gtan yul zin/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang 'od gsal rtse gcig tu sgoms/ /ngo mtshar rlung sems 'phrul gyi gnad/ /sems rtse gcig gyen du 'phang ba dang*/ /cir snang la bar do'i 'dun pa sbyongs/ /gang shar la dag snang lam khyer bya/ /'pho ba dang bar do'i gdams ngag zer/ /las dang po pa la gnad du che/ /sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i rang ngo la/ /gang shar rjen cher gyi ngang la zhog /sgo gsum ma bcos so ma'i ngang*/ /rang babs lhug pa'i gdams pa zer/ /sal le dang sing nge'i ngang du sgoms/ /lhod de dang shigs se'i rgya yan gyi ngang*/ /sems gang shar ngo shes kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /shar tsam nyid nas rang sar grol/ /ming yang rang grol gyi gdams ngag zer/ /gsal ba dang stong pa zug 'jug gsum/ /sems gnas sam 'gyu'am ci ltar rung*/ /gdod nas rang gnas kyi ngo shes la/ /sku gsum rang shar gyi gdams ngag zer/ /'gyu ba 'gyu stong gi ngang du thim/ /mnyam rjes kyi sa mtshams zhig nas thal/

/mdo rgyud kyi mkhyen rgya can mang lags shing*/ /gdams ngag gyi bdag po mang mod kyang*/ / don 'di las med ces bya ba nyung*/ /rang grol phyag chen gyi rnal 'byor 'di/ / mdo rgyud kyi snying por lags par 'khums/ /mi kho bos de ltar nyams su blangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang de ltar nyams len mdzod/ /rang shar phyogs med kyi dag snang gcig /gang snang mos gus kyi lam khyer la/ /mos gus kyi rtsa ba bla ma shar/ /bla ma yi dam dbyer med kyi ngang*/ /yi dam de sgyu mar rang shar gcig / rang shar ma bcos lhug pa'i gdangs/ /yin ni dag snang phyogs med kyi khrid/ / zer ni lam khyer rnam gsum zer/ /mi kho bos kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyangs/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyang dag snang phyogs med du sbyongs/ /thabs 'gags med kyi gnad de dag snang la gda'/ /sems gsal stong lha sku'i snang cha dang*/ / rang rig pa 'gyur med bde ba'i ngang*/ /de dang po nyid nas skye ba med/ /gang ma skyes pa la 'gag pa med/ /sems skye 'chi med pa'i rang bzhin de/ /'phral drin can gyi bla mas ngo sprod pa/ /ming yang rang sems 'chi med zer/ /bskyed rdzogs snying po dril ba gcig na gda'/ /rlung dang rnam rtog sems gsum po/ /dbyings su bsdoms pa nyams len gyi gnad/ /'khrul 'khor gyi kha bsgyur nyams len gyi rtsal/ /gzhan lus la thogs pa med pa yi/ /thig le 'dzag med kyi rang grol las/ /dga' bzhi dbyings su ngo sprod pa/ /ming ni rang lus 'chi med zer/ / rlung sems rang dbang du chub cig rnal 'byor pa/ /'phral 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgrub pa'i gnad/ /pha drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*/ /myur mdzad ye shes mgon po gnyis/ /mtshan tha dad don la khyad par med/ /mos gus nyag gcig gi rnal 'byor las/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi klong brdol nas/ /'gro don lhun grub tu 'char ba lags/ /dbyangs mchod pa 'bul lo mtshan ldan rje/

/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen nas brtsams te/ /pha rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad la/ / nyams dbyangs kyi glu 'di mchod pa 'bul/ khyed 'dir 'dus kyi skal ldan pho mo la/ /nges gsang bdud rtsi'i ro mchog 'di/ /dga' ston gyi tshul du byin pa lags/ /bdag phyogs ris med pa'i rgyal khams pa/ /ro snyoms kyi rnal 'byor gu yangs por/ /chos brgyad kyi dgra mkhar zhig pa zhig /gnyug ma'i gtan sa zin pa zhig /dngos kun gyi rang zhal lta ba po/ /chos tha snyad tshig la ma rmongs kyang*/ /mkhas 'dod kyi bzang 'dzin dbyings su grol/ /'phral lus sems tha mal du snang ba tsam/ /drin can gyi mkhan pos gnang ba'i ming*/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya yin/ /rang sems kyi rang bzhin ngo sprod pa/ /mi sangs rgyas su gtong ba'i bka' drin can/ /pha bla mas bka' drin bstsal pa ni/ /ming tā ra nā tha zhes bya yin/ /deng snying gtam gyi tshul du smras pa yin/ /ces pa'ang rang lo nyer lnga pa la ri gong dpal gyi mgon po'i gnas rang byung mgon po'i drung du tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i tshe glur blangs pa a+thi+-i/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mchog gi grub pa mngon tu gyur nas shugs 'byung gi spyod pas 'gro ba tshad med pa 'dul ba'i tshe rtags bdun bkra shis kyi rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs gsungs pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ bde chen chos sku'i rang nyams las/ /phyogs med kyi thugs rje'i 'gro don shar/ /pha rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag 'dir tshogs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /gzhan don phyogs med du 'phel ba 'di/ /sems stong nyid snying rjer shar ba'i rtags// gnas lugs kyi rang ngo 'phrod pa 'di/ /mos gus tshad du phyin pa'i rtags/ / nam yang yengs pa med pa 'di/ /rtsa bral gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ / rnam rtog gi skye thag chod pa 'di/ /rtog med kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtags/ /bde stong gi nyams myong rgyun chad med/

/rtsa thig rlung gsum dul ba'i rtags/ /spyod pa gza' gtad dang bral ba 'di/ /chos brgyad kyi rlung dmar zhi ba'i rtags/ /thob 'dod kyi re dogs zhig pa 'di/ /rang sems sangs rgyas su nges pa'i rtags/ /rtags 'di bdun tshang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sems bde zhing skyid pa'i rang so zin/ /blo mi bde mi gda' bde mor gda'/ /slar bde zhing skyid pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsungs so/ /༈ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i dbon lo chen 'gyur med bde chen gyi gsung mgur chos drug gi gsol 'debs bde chen char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ na maḥ shrī dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni gup+tā yai/ mkha' spyod kyi gtso mo thugs rje can/ /ye shes kyi gtso mo ni gu ma/ /bu gdung bas gsol ba 'di 'debs na/ /spros bral gyi dbyings nas dgongs su gsol/ /gsang chen gyi dkyil 'khor ston mkhas mas/ dga' bzhi yi dbang bskur da stsol cig /skye med kyi sgo mo 'byed mkhas mas/ /dag byed kyis sdig sgrib da sbyongs shig /a shad kyi gtum mo spro mkhas mas/ /snyigs ma yi phung khams da sregs shig /haṃ yig gi bde chen 'jo mkhas mas/ /lhan skyes kyi ye shes da stsol cig /sgyu ma yi rang nyams ston mkhas mas/ /chags sdang gi bden 'dzin da shigs shig /rmi lam gyi dus na sprul bsgyur mas/ /nying 'khrul gyi 'ching ba da chod cig /lhun grub 'od gsal 'char mdzad mas/ /gti mug gi mun pa da sol cig /'da' kha yi dus su yang 'dren mas/ /mkha' spyod kyi gnas su da khrid cig /bar do yi 'khrul snang 'joms mdzad mas/ /gzhom med kyi longs sku da rtsol cig /ces chos smra ba 'gyur med bde chen gyi gsol ba btab pa'o/ /༈ rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung ba nyams rtogs mkhyen rab kyi rtsa kha bye ba zhwa lu pa rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong gi gsung mgur phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i dran tho'i nyams glu yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/

/ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ni gu ma'i/ /thugs bdud rtsi'i yang zhun tā la'i 'dab/ /tshig yi ger btab nas gā'ur bcug /rje khyung po'i mgul la mdzes so skad/ /mgon de dang dbyer med chos kyi rje/ /pha mthu stobs zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ /chos phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i/ khrid dmigs rim thob pa'i dran tho brjod/ /lam sngon 'gro rang babs rnam gsum dang*/ /don dngos gzhi skyon tshogs bzhi las grol/ / mthar sku bzhi'i rang zhal lhun grub pa/ /de lam bzang 'di yi khyad chos nyid/ / a ho/ ma bcos 'phro bcad dang zhe bcad sgrim zhing glod/ /mtho dman nye ring dang chos spyod sngags dang sgra/ /spyod lam nges med zhi gnas sems 'dzin yin// ngo bo skye 'gag dang yul snang rnam rtog 'tshol/ /de gnyis yod med kyi khyad 'tshol gnyis re drug /rang bzhin chos dbyings su sems thag bcad de bdun// lhag mthong ngo sprad de tsit+ta'i dkyil du zhog /rang bab rnam gsum la sgom tshul bco brgyad yod/ /kye ho/ nye drags nas de ko ngo ma shes/ /zab drags nas de nyid ngos ma zin/ /sla drags nas de la yid ma ches/ /bzang drags nas de blor ma shong 'dug /da chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum/ /sems gsal stong zung 'jug sbubs nas thon/ /de dbyer med ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ /rang rig stong sems kyi rtsal du rdzogs/ /mdangs mos gus snying rje thabs dang gsum/ /thabs rlung dang bskyed rim zung 'jug bsre/ /bogs rgyangs kyis thon pa'i lag cha yin/ / gegs byung na sel thabs gnyis po shog /pha bla ma'i man ngag yid bzhin nor// sems brjed ngas rkun pos 'phrog dogs nas/ /dpal zhwa lu ri phug yang dben du/ /ban blo gsal bstan skyong zhes pas smras/ /phyag rgya chen po gwa'u ma'i dran tho'i nyams glu'o/ /༈ rtsod dus shin tu snyigs ma'i skabs su u dum+ba ra ltar dkon la don che ba ngo mtshar sprul pa'i skyes mchog bka' babs bdun gyi mnga' bdag 'gran zla dang bral ba'i rnam par thar pa rmad du byung bas gangs can gyi khor yug na yongs su grags pa'i mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i dgongs klong ye shes kyi gter mdzod nas shugs 'byung du brdol ba'i rdo rje'i glu zab cing rgya che ba las skabs su babs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug brtson 'grus bzang po'i nang gi rnam par thar pa la bsngags pa'i rdo rje'i thol glu rig pa 'dzin pa'i me tog ces bya ba/

a ho/ srid gsum dus gcig za ba'i tsaṇ+ḍā lir/ /haṃ yig bdud rtsi'i bgo bshar sbyin pa yis/ /'bar 'dzag dbu mar thim pa'i ye shes sku/ /bde stong gtum mo'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /dkar mar thig le'i 'bros 'ded la goms pas/ /'pho med dga' bas tshims pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ / nying 'khrul rang sar dag pa'i nā da'i gsung*/ /gsal stong rmi lam pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /rab zhi skye med bdud rtsi'i rlabs 'thung bas/ /zab mo'i don la bzod pa'i pad+mo ni/ /zla bral mtshar sdug rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i thugs/ /rig stong 'od gsal pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /chos kun bden med goms pa'i blo gros dang*/ /gcig tu 'dza' ba'i brtson 'grus brtsams pa yis/ /nye 'khon las 'das lhun grub yon tan dbyings/ /snang stong sgyu lus pha rol phyin la 'dud/ / don dam 'gro 'ong sred len ma mchis kyang*/ /kun rdzob srog rtsol sbyor ba'i bsam gtan gyis/ /'phyugs med mkha' spyod grub pa'i 'phrin las can/ /tshor stong 'pho ba'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /bar srid 'khrul ba'i snang cha ji snyed kun// lha sngags chos skur rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ /zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs skur ldang nus pa'i/ /myong stong bar do'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /mdor na nges don pha rol phyin drug dang*/ /dbyer med rdo rje'i chos drug la goms pas/ /sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las mi zad pa/ /rtag pa dam pa'i pha rol phyin la 'dud/ /de ltar gus pa'i nyi gzhon bcud g.yo bas/ /rig 'dzin dgyes pa'i tshig sbyor ut+pa la/ /'dzum bcas rol 'dis mgon po khyod nyid dang*/ /dbyer med grub pa'i rnam thar 'dzin par shog /ces bsil ljongs grub rigs rgya mtsho'i khyu mchog pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul thang stong pa'i nang gi rnam par thar pa la ye shes kyi ḍā ki ni gu mas bkral ba'i rdo rje'i chos drug gi sgo nas bsngags pa'i glu dbyangs 'di'ang rje de nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas shrī dza la sarba ta'i lcags zam dang nye ba'i gnas lo hi ta'i phung po dal gyis 'babs pa rkang 'thung gi lang tshos bkra ba'i gzings kyi 'khrul 'khor la brten nas brgal ba'i lam bar kho na bris te gsol ba btab pa'o/

/zab don bsdus pa'i rdo rje'i thol glu nges don them skas zhes bya ba/ e ma ho/ gzung 'dzin las 'das gdod ma'i de bzhin nyid/ /spros pa kun bral 'od gsal gnyug ma'i gshis/ /'gyur med bde ba chen pos rab 'khyud pa'i// rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan snying gar rol/ /sbas don gsang ba'i de nyid ston pa yi/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams kyi dgongs pa'i bcud/ /rab mthong min kyang gang shar rdo rje'i glus/ /zab mo dga' ba'i chu rgyun deng 'dir 'bebs/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas lugs nges pa'i don/ /kun tu rtogs nas gnad du bsnun pa yis/ /bde stong ye shes skye bar rab gzigs nas/ /thabs lam zab mo rdzogs pa'i rim pa bstan/ /de la bkod pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung*/ /thig le byang chub sems mchog rnam pa gsum/ /chags gnas 'jigs gsum mdzad pa rdzogs pa'i gar/ /rang bzhin ye shes chen po'i rten du gnas/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo rnam pa bzhi ldan pa'i/ /mdud pa kun na thabs shes ma ning gi /yi ge gsum dang srog rtsol mnyam pa'i rlung*/ /de bzhin bde stong 'khril sbyor thig le ste/ /gsum tshan rim pas bde gsal mi rtog kyi/ /chos nyid bskyed dang sku gsum rten 'brel 'grub/ /rdo rje'i chos dang ldan pa rtsa yi lam/ /gcud cing 'khrul 'khor bya ba rtsa yi gnad/ /srol rtsol bum par bskyil ba rlung gi lam/ /

sbyor ba bzhi ldan rlung gi gnad mchog yin/ /a haṃ zhu bde'i 'bros 'ded thig le'i lam/ /'khor lo bzhi ru bcings pa thig le'i gnad/ /snang stong lha skur lta ba sgyu lus lam/ /zhen med sprul pa ldang ba sgyu lus gnad/ /nyal khar 'dun pas gcun pa rmi lam lam/ /nyal slong skye med la gzhol rmi lam gnad/ /snod bcud dwangs mar bsdu ba 'od gsal lam/ /rlung sems mnyam par 'ching ba 'od gsal gnad/ /chos nyid rnam gsum dran pa bar do'i lam/ /rtag tu 'khrul bar blta ba bar do'i gnad/ /tshangs bug dwangs ma 'pho ba 'pho ba'i lam/ /rlung sems bsdu zhing bkag pa 'pho ba'i gnad/ /de ltar rtsa ba yan lag rim pa yis/ /zab mo rdzogs pa'i don rnams bsdus pa ste/ /gzhan du rlung la gnad du bsnun pa yis/ /gsal ba'i nyams dang thig le bde ba nyid/ /'thob byed so sor dbye bas rab tu bstan/ /mi rtog mtshan ma med pa'i rdzogs rim ni/ /gdod nas ma skyes mkha' 'dra'i 'od gsal don/ /chos dang gang zag bdag gis ma bcings pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi mchog tu rnam par gnas/ /de phyir phyag rgya chen po blo yul las/ /'das pa'i yid la mi byed snying po'i don/ /rab kyi dam pas ngo sprod de ma thag /gcer mthong skyes nas rang bzhin ngang gis grol/ /gzhan dag myong ba gang skyes der bstun nas/ /rlung sems thig le'i gnad kyis gcun pa yis/ /brten pa 'od gsal bsam mi khyab par 'char/ / de skad du yang rje btsun te lo pas/ /blo dman skye bo don la mi gnas na/ /rlung gi gnad bzung rig pa gcud la bor/ /lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis/ /rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun/ /dper na nam mkha'i dkyil ni brtag byas nas/ /mtha' dang dbus su 'dzin pa 'gag par 'gyur/ /de bzhin sems kyis sems la brtag byas na/ /rnam rtog tshogs 'gag thog med gnas 'gyur nas/ /bla med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin mthong*/

/zhes gsungs de phyir zab mo'i gsang lam gyi/ /thabs la brten nas gnad kyis gcun pa yis/ /brtson 'grus dag dang dbang po'i bgo skal las/ /dus gsum sgrol ba snying po'i don mchog go /rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i zhal lung nges pa'i don/ /rang gi rgyud la myong ba ma skyes shing*/ /mos pas spyod pa'i gral mthar lhung gyur phyir/ / 'di ltar smra bar 'os min de lta na'ang*/ /gang shar rdo rje'i rol mor 'khrol ba la/ /nyes pa'i tshogs kun rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor la/ /mi 'chab mthol zhing dge tshogs gang mchis des/ /'gro kun phyag rgya che la gnas par shog /grag stong rdo rje'i thol glu sgyu ma'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba/ a ho/ tshogs brgyad 'khrul ba zad pa yi/ /gzhi grol ka dag dpal gyi ri/ /'od gsal sgyu mar rol pa'i gar/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshom bur 'dud/ /yang grag stong glu yi mchod pa yis/ /dpal bo ḍā ki dgyes phyir len/ /rtsa dag pa rab 'byams kyi mgrin pa nas/ /snang stong bskyed rim gyi glu glangs pas/ /kun btags 'khrul ba'i phung khams tshogs/ /gdan gsum lha yi sku ru thim/ /rlung dbu mar rol pa'i mgrin pa nas/ /gsal stong bzlas brjod kyi glu blangs pas/ /sgra tshig rang mtshan zhen pa kun/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i ngang du thim/ / thig le bde chen gyi mgrin pa nas/ /bde stong dga' bzhi yi glu blangs pas/ / tha mal nyon mongs kyi 'ching ba kun/ /zung 'jug 'od gsal ngang du thim/ / rang rig brjod med kyi mgrin pa nas/ /ngang bzhag lhun 'byams kyi glu blangs pas/ /sna tshogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa kun/ /shar grol dus mnyam gyi ngang du thim/ /ka ti shel spug gi mgrin pa nas/ /'ja' zer thig le yi glu blangs pas/ /phung khams gdos bcas kyi mtshan ma kun/ /chos zad blo 'das kyi ngang du thim/ /sgo gsum cha snyoms kyi mgrin pa nas/ /bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyi glu blangs pas/

/'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog tshogs kun/ /byar med 'bras bu'i klong du thim/ /chos dred skal dman gyi mgrin pa nas/ /sna tshogs grag stong gi glu blangs pas/ /byed snyam bsgrub 'dod kyi dam chos kun/ /le lo phyi bshol gyi ngang du thim/ /de nges don glu yi mchod pa yin/ /rang rgyud la skyo ba'i gdung dbyangs yin/ /dge ba des ma rtogs 'gro ba'i khams/ /rang rig gi ngo bor lhun grub shog /ces gsungs so/ /༈ tshad ma'i skyes bu rnams kyis rgyal bas lung bstan par bsngags pa 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i gsung zab lam ni gu chos drug sogs dpal ldan shangs pa'i gser chos kyi rdo rje'i gnas nges pa'i mgrin glu ka la piṅka'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba/ rdo rje 'chang chen nas brtsams te brgyud pa rin po che rnam bdun/ /mi min mi yi tshul bzung rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyi gser phreng*/ /sangs rgyas rjen par stsol ba'i dpal ldan rtsa ba yi bla ma/ /zhabs kyi pad mor 'dud do nyams rtogs gong 'phel du mdzod cig /e ma/ snying po'i lam 'dir kho bo skal ba ni bzang ldan/ /rdo rje 'chang gi zhal lung ye shes ḍā ki yi gsang tshig /grub thob brgyud pa'i nyams myong rtsa ba'i bla ma yi pha phogs/ /snying gi nor bur bcangs pas blo yis gtad so 'dra bdog go / gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa gyi drin las/ /mdo sngags chos kyi rin chen kun la thang ma ru brdal yang*/ /grub thob bar ma chad cing myong rtags mngon sum du thon pa/ /mkhas grub khyung po'i gser chos yid bzhin nor bu las lhag go /mthar thug rnam lnga ston mdzad su kha sid+dhi dang ni gu gsang ba'i lam mchog snang byed ye shes dkyil 'khor ni lnga ldan/ /bshad sgrub bka' srol 'dzin pa sar gnas byang sems kyi gdung brgyud/ /ma bsgrubs byin rlabs sgo 'char bsgrubs na grub pa lta ci smos/

/mkha' lding khyung chen zhes pa'i ming gi mngon brjod tsam kho nas/ /bya bran gzhan gyi gnas lugs ji mi snyam pa yi sems thob/ khyung po'i gser chos zhes pa'i mtshan gyi gzi brjid kyi zil gyis// rang rtog yi ge ris la gus pa lhod po ru byed do/ kha nag yig nag sprad pa'i bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod ni bye bas/ /chos 'di yud tsam sgom pa'i nyams myong rtag tshad la mi nye/ /rtog ge'i rig pa'i 'khor lo lo dang zla ba ru bskor yang*/ / don 'di nyams su blangs pa'i shes rab cha shas su mi phyin/ /deng sang dus kyi dbang gis rtse gcig sgom nus mkhan dkon kyang*/ /yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i chos la nges shes ni chen pos/ /spang blang res 'jog med par rgyun gyi nyams len tsam 'bad na/ /ring min mchog dngos grub pa ye shes mkha' 'gro yi tha tshig /sgrub la snying rus chung bas nyams rtogs rtsal kha ni ma rdzogs/ / col chung rnam par g.yeng bas drod tshad mngon sum 'dra dben kyang*/ /dkar po'i las kyi 'phro yis chos 'dir yid ches ni gdeng khel/ /snying dang srog ltar gces pa'i mos pa lhan skyes su 'dug go /gser chos rin chen mdzod las rgyud chen sde lnga yi yang bcud/ /mtshan gyi grags pa gsal ldan rtsa ba ni gu yi chos drug /stan thog gcig gi steng du nyams rtogs myu gu ni 'khrungs pa/ /tshe lus gcig gi khongs su mchog gi 'bras ster 'di rmad do/ /gdod nas skye med yig 'bru 'khor 'das chos kun gyi sgo mo/ /bde chen 'khor lor shar ba'i dag byed bdud rtsi yi khrus kyis/ /sdig sgrib nad gdon bkrus las stong gsal rjen pa yi nyams ldan/ /dag byed stong ra'i thabs 'di gnad du phyin pa yi sngon 'gro/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrubs na bde stong zung 'jug las gzhan pa'i/ /thabs lam yod pa ma yin de rgyu rang lus ni thabs ldan/ /rtsa rgod rlung rgod 'dul la gtum mo me rgod nyid myur bas/

/bdun phrag gsum gyi zhag nas ras dkar bla gos kyis 'khyongs so/ /rten gzhi rdo rje'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i stong rar/ /sbyor ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i bum can tshad ldan tu khegs pas/ /a haṃ 'bar 'dzag 'phrul las skad cig dga' ba bzhis brgyan pa/ /thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar 'phags bod grub thob kyi snying nor/ /gtum mo zas su zos pas bde stong gzhon sha ni chags la/ /gtum mo gos su gyon pas bde drod bzod med du 'bar ba/ /gdan bting rta ru bzhon pas brtan cing gang 'dod du phyin pa/ /thun mong tsam dang mi mnyam bla med rgyud rgyal gyi dgongs pa/ /mos gus bla ma'i lam las cir snang bden med du shar zhing*/ /snang stong lha sku rang shar cir snang sgyu ma ru mthong ba/ /sgyu lus snying po yin kyang nyams 'og chud pa ni dkon 'dug /bla ma grub pa'i dbang pos thugs nyams mthil phyin du myong song*/ /sad pa'i rkyen bzhi bral bas 'gro drug sgyu ma ru 'char byed/ /'dun pa brgyad gsum sbrags shing nad gdon sgyu ma ltar shes pas/ /yon tan tshogs drug 'char zhing a 'thas sbrul mdud nyid bkrol ba/ /dang po'i las can rnams la snying gi bdud rtsi ru 'dug go /nying 'khrul snang ba rang zin dbang bzhi thig le yi gdams ngag /ma zin 'phyug med gnad dgus 'khrul ba thug phrad du bzung nas/ /sbyong spel sgyur ba'i gnad kyis rang rtsal phyogs med du sbyangs pas/ /yul snang gtan la pheb cing rmi lam rnam thar yang 'byongs te/ /rtsol med lha sku rang shar mthar thug 'od gsal du bstims las/ /nying 'khrul btsan thabs gcod pa'i gdams ngag zab dgu yi yang rtse/ /blun po ba glang rdzi yang sangs rgyas nyin rgyugs su btang 'dir/ /bla ma sangs rgyas drin las 'brel ba g.yar khral tsam bzhag go /mi rtag skyo shas spyod lam dam rdzas thabs lam dang gsol 'debs/ /rtsa ba yal ga lo ma me tog 'khri shing ni rgyas las/

/ srab mthug 'od gsal 'bras bu bzung zhing sku gsum du khyer te/ /gsal stong mnyam bzhag rjes thob nyin mtshan bde stong dag bsres pas/ /gti mug gnyid kyi mun khang 'od gsal sgron me yis bcom ste/ /rlung sems 'dus pa'i rten 'brel khyad par bla ma yi byin gyis/ /bde gsal stong pa dbyer med zab zhi spros bral gyi 'od gsal/ khor mo yug gi sbubs su gnyis snang bar lag 'dra 'gyes so/ /chos sku de bzhin nyid de longs sku zung 'jug gi yid dam/ /byin rlabs bla ma'i stobs dang 'phyug med mkha' spyod kyi gong 'phel/ /dbang po'i rim dang mthun par 'da' kha'i mtshams sbyor 'dra bgyid pa/ /da lta'i sngags spyod kun gyi bskyed rdzogs grub mtha' ni 'di'o/ /'od gsal chos kyi sku dang rgyal ba longs spyod ni rdzogs pa/ /sprul sku 'gags med rang shar spyi gnas 'phyug med dang bcas pas/ /bar do gsum las grol byed dbang po'i rim pa dang mthun par/ /dal dus grabs su btsud pas brel dus sleb par ni 'gyur ro/ /sngon 'gro rang bab gsum gyis zhi lhag ting 'dzin ni bskyed nas/ /dngos gzhi ngo sprod zab mos skyon bzhi rang grol du btang ste/ /rjes shes gsal stong zung 'jug sku gsum rang shar du shes pa/ /phyag rgya chen po'i lam 'di chos kyi sdong po nyid yin no/ /ye shes ḍā ki rnam gnyis mai tri gup+ta yi zhal lung*/ /bzo med rang bab ngo bo glang chen lta stangs dang 'grogs pas/ /ngos bzung kun dang bral ba'i tha mal shes pa ni so ma/ /sku gsum rjen par 'char bas sangs rgyas sbar bcangs su rnyed do/ /cir snang bla mar shes pa'i mos gus phyogs med ni dang po/ /snang grags lha sngags rang bzhin dag snang phyogs med ni gnyis pa/ / snang sems sgyu ma rmi lam bden med lam khyer ni gsum pa/ /yal gar mtshan tu gsol yang mdo sngags chos kun gyi snying po/ /zla ba li khri'i mdangs can rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ting 'dzin/

khyad 'phags gsol 'debs shugs kyis snying rje'i chu rgyun ni bskul zhing*/ /'khor lo bzhi yi mar me chags grol bde stong la bslabs pas/ /mkha' spyod me tog tshal du lhan skyes mdzes ma yis bsu'o/ / rang sems skye ba med pas 'gags shing 'chi ba yang med la/ /lus nyid bem po'i rang bzhin 'chi ba'i gdags gzhi tsam ma grub/ /rlung sems dbyings su bsdoms shing 'khrul 'khor kha lo 'dra bsgyur bas/ /'dzag med dga' bzhi'i yo lang 'bras bu thang brdal du spyad chog /bla ma mgon po dbyer med sku lnga'i 'phrul chen ni bsgyur bas/ /las bzhi mchog gi dngos grub lo zla'i shas tsam gyis ster ba/ /lhag par bar do'i 'jigs skyobs myur mdzad spyan ras ni gzigs dbang*/ /mos gus snying rje'i phyag rgyas gtan gyi snying nor du bcangs yod/ /sangs rgyas thub pa'i bstan pa drang nges rang thad du bden cing*/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag che bshad rang sa na yod kyang*/ /gzhan la mtshan tsam dkon pa mkhas grub khyung po yi gser chos/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud la 'thung tshe chang la 'gram chu 'dra mi ldangs/ /byed lugs zom zom ngang la bsam lugs don thog tu bcar ba/ /snang lugs klad med 'dra la yin lugs gcig thog tu grims pa/ /zer lugs bcos ma nyid la byung lugs rang bzhin gyi bab gshis/ /btang snyoms sdod par ma nus sprang po blo gros kyi sug rjes/ /skye dang tshe rabs kun tu gser chos yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /snying gi dpal ber bcangs te zung 'jug rdo rje yi rgyal sar/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol ba'i skyob pa gnyis med ni gzigs pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs rjes myur du 'grub pa ru mdzod cig /ces pa'ang kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru'i don chen rdo rje'i ljags brgyangs pas mos pa'i myu gu bsros pa las smra ba'i pad+mo dbang med du kha bye ste dben pa'i skyed tshal de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi g.yon mgul du/

pad+ma'i 'bangs spong ba pa'i gzugs brnyan yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes zab don bung ba'i mgrin glu cung zad cig blangs pa dge/ //༈ /de ltar mgur rnams mos gus kyi shugs dang nyams rtogs kyi rtsal bskyed de legs par blangs pa'i mthar tshogs kyi yo byad ci ltar 'byor pa bshams la/ byin brlabs nas lhag ma'i bar bde mchog lha lnga'i cho ga lta bu btang*/ tshogs mgron la nongs bshags bzod gsol dang rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ bsngo ba khyung pos mdzad pa'i bka' rgya mar grags pa ni/ sku gsum mkhyen bcu chos kyi rje sogs/ bkra shis bka' rgya ma brjod la phyogs dus yul khams thams cad dge legs dpal gyis khyab par bya'o/ /bka' brgyud rin po che'i phyag srol la rdo rje'i mgur len pa shin tu gal po che mdzad cing dar srol che yang*/ shangs pa bka' brgyud pa'i ring lugs phyogs 'dir dar srol chung bas grub thob brgyud pa rnams kyi gsung mgur dpe tsam yang nyin mo'i skar ma'i rjes su song bas/ rnam thar sogs las byung ba gtso bor byas/ brgyud pa phyi ma ci rigs pa'i gsung gis kyang kha bskangs te brgyud pa 'di'i zab chos kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog ji snyed sngon dge ba'i gser snod du 'khyil ba/ karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i blo gros mtha' yas pa'i sdes dpal de bī ko ṭi tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi dben khrod du 'du bgyis pa dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //dge legs 'phel// ༈ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang ḍā ki nī/ /grub thob brgyud pa rim par byon rnams kyi/ /rang byung rang shar mi shig nā da'i sgra/ /thos pa don ldan byin rlabs kun 'byung phyir/ /rim gnyis ting 'dzin la gnas rnal 'byor ram/ /dad mos rtse gcig ldan pa'i gang zag gis/

/rdo rje'i do ha dbyangs su len pa der/ /bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs/ /yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong gegs sel 'phrin las sgrub/ /dkar phyogs skyong rnams dgyes shing gzi mdangs skyed/ /nag phyogs dpa' zhum byang sems bdud rtsis brlan/ /nyams kyi rtsal skyed rtogs pa'i bogs bton cing*/ /dad ldan rnams la thar pa'i sa bon bskrun/ /de ltar don chen 'bras bzang smin pa'i phyir/ /tshar du dngar ba'i nor bu'i phreng ba rnams/ /dad blo gser gyi skud par legs brgyus pa/ /gcig las du mar 'phel ba'i par nyid gang*/ /byed po rang gi lhag bsam dag pas bskrun/ /dge bas bdag gzhan 'brel thogs gtsor gyur pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi thogs med sgrib pa bral/ /byang chub sems mchog rnam gnyis rtsol med du/ /rgyud la skyes nas gnas lugs mngon du gyur/ /grub thob brgyud pa'i rnam thar yongs rdzogs nas/ /bde can zhing du pad+mor brdzus te skyes/ /'od dpag med las lung bstan mchog thob ste/ /sa lam myur bgrod 'phrin las tshad med pas/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro kun byang chub sar 'god pa/ /rgyal mchog snang mtha' yas dang mtshungs par shog

/thugs bskyed rlabs che smon lam mthu btsan pa'i/ /bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa yis/ /'dir btab smon bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /ces spar byang smon tshig bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi grangs ldan 'di'ang rnam dkar bgyi ba'i byed po ku sā li blo gros mtha' yas kyis brjod pa dge legs 'phel// // mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang las/ zhi byed dang shangs pa'i chos skor/do ha rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang mgur dbyangs phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa/ - PAGE 118 -- PAGE 215 -- PAGE 117 -
